title: The first transition: physical roots and native rank

blocks.tex:
This chapter proves the first of the three physical producers used in
\cref{thm:four_active_adjacent_unequal}: at the \emph{first transition} of
the first-pair flag along a strictly rising leg of the curvature word, the
four actual edges $0,i-1,i,n-1$ carry a regular four-edge anchor
(\cref{def:regular_four_anchor}).  Everything is proved in Lean; the chapter
explains the proof.  The final statements are \cref{thm:nfp_transition}
(four endpoint readings) and \cref{thm:nfp_rising_anchor} (an actual rising
interval of an actual word).

The argument has four parts.
\begin{enumerate}
  \item \textbf{The native model} (\cref{sec:nfp_model}).  For the endpoint
    readings that occur, the frame controller of
    \cref{def:four_active_controller} is literally an explicit map of four
    half-lengths.  Substituting sines of four acute angles turns its three
    real equations into two ``seams'' and one ``chord'' equation
    (\cref{lem:nfp_native_equations}).
  \item \textbf{Rank} (\cref{sec:nfp_rank}).  At \emph{every} physical zero
    of the native model, whatever its origin, the derivative with respect to
    the four half-lengths is surjective (\cref{thm:nfp_native_rank}).
  \item \textbf{Roots} (\cref{sec:nfp_pure} and \cref{sec:nfp_ordered}).  A physical
    zero exists.  When the reading $t$ before the high pair is at most the
    reading $p$ after the peak, a boundary strip and an inward
    intermediate-value argument give it (\cref{thm:nfp_pure_root}); when
    $p<t$, a crossed winding argument on the original residual rectangle
    gives it (\cref{thm:nfp_ordered_anchor}).
  \item \textbf{Selection} (\cref{sec:nfp_selection}).  The least index at
    which the flag becomes nonnegative is a transition with the hypotheses
    of the two root theorems, and the frame at that index packages the
    zero as an anchor of the original word.
\end{enumerate}
No step assumes a continuation path, a limiting realization, a producer
premise or a rank hypothesis.

Throughout the chapter the word has been normalized so that the selected
low peak has reading $1$.  The four selected edges, in cyclic order, have
literal endpoint readings
\[
  \text{edge }0:(1,p),\qquad \text{edge }1:(t,q),\qquad
  \text{edge }2:(q,h),\qquad \text{edge }3:(l,1).
\]
So the frame's start vector is $(1,t,q,l)$ and its finish vector is
$(p,q,h,1)$.  Between consecutive selected edges the block turn of
\cref{def:four_active_controller} involves the \emph{corner slots}
\[
  (1,1)\ \text{(between edges $3$ and $0$)},\quad (p,t),\quad (q,q),\quad
  (h,l)\ \text{(between edges $2$ and $3$)} .
\]
The slots $(1,1)$ and $(q,q)$ are \emph{pure}: both incident endpoint
readings are equal.  The slots $(p,t)$ and $(h,l)$ are \emph{mixed}.  In the
application $0<p,l<1$ (neighbours of a strict local maximum),
$1<q<h$ (a strictly rising pair above the peak) and $0<t<q$.

blocks.label: def:nfp_native_model
blocks.title: native four-half-length model
blocks.body:
For $L=(L_0,L_1,L_2,L_3)\in\RR^4$ put
  \[
    \theta_0=\arcsin L_3+\arcsin L_0,\quad
    \theta_1=\arcsin(pL_0)+\arcsin(tL_1),\quad
    \theta_2=\arcsin(qL_1)+\arcsin(qL_2),\quad
    \theta_3=\arcsin(hL_2)+\arcsin(lL_3)
  \]
  (\verb|lengthTurns|), and with $u(x)=e^{ix}$
  \[
    N(L)=\Bigl(L_0+L_1u(\theta_1)+L_2u(\theta_1+\theta_2)+
      L_3u(\theta_1+\theta_2+\theta_3),\ \
      \theta_0+\theta_1+\theta_2+\theta_3-2\pi\Bigr)\in\CC\times\RR
  \]
  (\verb|nativeLengthController p t q h l|).  The first component is the
  complex half-closure in the heading gauge of edge $0$, the second the real
  full-turn defect.  The tuple $L$ is \emph{physical}
  (\verb|NativeLengthPhysical|) if $L_j>0$ for all $j$ and all eight literal
  endpoint walls hold:
  \[
    L_0<1,\quad pL_0<1,\quad tL_1<1,\quad qL_1<1,\quad qL_2<1,\quad
    hL_2<1,\quad lL_3<1,\quad L_3<1 .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.NativeLengthPhysical
Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.nativeLengthController
lean.code:
noncomputable def nativeLengthController (p t q h l : ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℂ × ℝ :=
  let θ := lengthTurns p t q h l L
  ((L 0 : ℂ) + (L 1 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1) +
    (L 2 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2) +
    (L 3 : ℂ) * unitPhase (θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3),
    θ 0 + θ 1 + θ 2 + θ 3 - 2 * Real.pi)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.lengthTurns
lean.code:
noncomputable def lengthTurns (p t q h l : ℝ) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ :=
  ![Real.arcsin (L 3) + Real.arcsin (L 0),
    Real.arcsin (p * L 0) + Real.arcsin (t * L 1),
    Real.arcsin (q * L 1) + Real.arcsin (q * L 2),
    Real.arcsin (h * L 2) + Real.arcsin (l * L 3)]

blocks.tex:
The half-length convention is that of \cref{def:four_active_controller}: the
ambient full length of selected edge $j$ is $2L_j$, so the wall $sL_j<1$ is
the moderate-arc wall $s\ell_j/2<1$ at an endpoint of reading $s$.  No factor
of two is lost: $N$ is the frame controller itself, not a rescaled copy.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_to_anchor
blocks.title: the native model is the frame controller
blocks.body:
Let $F$ be a frame for a word $\kappa$ with
  $\operatorname{start}(\kappa)=(1,t,q,l)$ and
  $\operatorname{finish}(\kappa)=(p,q,h,1)$.  Then $C^F_\kappa=N$ as
  functions on $\RR^4$.  Consequently, if $L$ is physical, $N(L)=0$ and
  $DN(L)$ is surjective, then $(F,L)$ is a regular four-edge anchor of
  $\kappa$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.RegularFourAnchor.ofNative
lean.code:
noncomputable def ofNative {n : ℕ} {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (F : FourActiveSlots.Frame n) {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hstart : F.start κ = ![1, t, q, l])
    (hfinish : F.finish κ = ![p, q, h, 1])
    (hphysical : NativeOppositePure.NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l L)
    (hzero : NativeOppositePure.nativeLengthController p t q h l L = 0)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective
      (fderiv ℝ (NativeOppositePure.nativeLengthController p t q h l) L)) :
    RegularFourAnchor κ := by
  rcases hphysical with ⟨hL, h0, hp0, ht1, hq1, hq2, hh2, hl3, h3⟩
  have hfun : F.controller κ = NativeOppositePure.nativeLengthController p t q h l :=
    funext (F.controller_eq_nativeLengthController hstart hfinish)
  refine ⟨F, L, hL, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    rw [hstart]
    fin_cases j
    · simpa using h0
    · exact ht1
    · exact hq2
    · exact hl3
  · intro j
    rw [hfinish]
    fin_cases j
    · exact hp0
    · exact hq1
    · exact hh2
    · simpa using h3
  · rwa [hfun]
  · rwa [hfun]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.Frame.controller_eq_nativeLengthController
lean.code:
theorem controller_eq_nativeLengthController
    {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hstart : F.start κ = ![1, t, q, l])
    (hfinish : F.finish κ = ![p, q, h, 1]) (L : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    F.controller κ L = NativeOppositePure.nativeLengthController p t q h l L := by
  have hturn : F.turns κ L = NativeOppositePure.lengthTurns p t q h l L := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;>
      simp [turns, startArc, finishArc, hstart, hfinish, NativeOppositePure.lengthTurns]
  simp only [controller, NativeOppositePure.nativeLengthController, hturn]

blocks.tex:
Write $\sigma_j=\operatorname{start}_j$ and $\tau_j=\operatorname{finish}_j$.
  The frame turns are $\Theta_0=\arcsin(\tau_3L_3)+\arcsin(\sigma_0L_0)$,
  $\Theta_1=\arcsin(\tau_0L_0)+\arcsin(\sigma_1L_1)$, and so on
  (\cref{def:four_active_controller}).  Substituting
  $\sigma=(1,t,q,l)$ and $\tau=(p,q,h,1)$ gives exactly
  $\Theta_j=\theta_j$ for $j=0,1,2,3$, hence equal controllers for every
  $L$, and therefore equal derivatives at every point.  The four positivity
  conditions are the same, and the eight anchor inequalities $\sigma_jL_j<1$,
  $\tau_jL_j<1$ are, after substitution, exactly the eight walls of
  \verb|NativeLengthPhysical| ($1\cdot L_0<1$, $tL_1<1$, $qL_2<1$, $lL_3<1$
  for the starts; $pL_0<1$, $qL_1<1$, $hL_2<1$, $1\cdot L_3<1$ for the
  finishes).  So the four fields of \cref{def:regular_four_anchor} hold.

On the physical domain write the half-lengths as sines of acute angles:
$\alpha,\beta$ at the pure $1$-corner and $\gamma,\delta$ at the pure
$q$-corner,
\[
  L=\bigl(\sin\alpha,\ \sin\gamma/q,\ \sin\delta/q,\ \sin\beta\bigr).
\]
Geometrically, the two edges at the pure $1$-corner are chords
$2\sin\beta,2\sin\alpha$ of a circle of radius $1$, the corner turns by
$\alpha+\beta$, and the diagonal joining the two mixed corners has length
$2\sin(\alpha+\beta)$; at the pure $q$-corner the same diagonal has length
$2\sin(\gamma+\delta)/q$.

blocks.label: def:nfp_split_model
blocks.title: split-angle equations
blocks.body:
Let $\operatorname{atom}(a,z)=\arcsin(a\sin z)$ and
  \[
    \Lambda=\operatorname{atom}(p,\alpha)+\operatorname{atom}(t/q,\gamma),\qquad
    \Upsilon=\operatorname{atom}(h/q,\delta)+\operatorname{atom}(l,\beta)
  \]
  (the turns at the mixed slots $(p,t)$ and $(h,l)$).  The \emph{low seam},
  \emph{high seam}, \emph{chord} and \emph{turn defect} are
  \begin{align*}
    H&=\beta+\delta+\Lambda-\pi, &
    K&=\alpha+\gamma+\Upsilon-\pi,\\
    M&=\sin(\alpha+\beta)-\sin(\gamma+\delta)/q, &
    D&=(\alpha+\beta)+(\gamma+\delta)+\Lambda+\Upsilon-2\pi,
  \end{align*}
  so that $H+K=D$.  The split half-closure is
  \[
    E=\sin\alpha+\tfrac{\sin\gamma}{q}\,u(\Lambda)
      +\tfrac{\sin\delta}{q}\,u(\Lambda+\gamma+\delta)
      +\sin\beta\,u(\Lambda+\gamma+\delta+\Upsilon).
  \]
  The angles are \emph{strict} (\verb|StrictAngles|) if
  $\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta\in(0,\pi/2)$ and $(h/q)\sin\delta<1$.
  With a fixed second pure turn $T$ and coordinates $x=(S,\alpha,\gamma)$
  we write $\beta=S-\alpha$, $\delta=T-\gamma$ and
  $\operatorname{split}(x)=(\sin\alpha,\sin\gamma/q,\sin(T-\gamma)/q,
  \sin(S-\alpha))$ (\verb|splitHalfLengths q T x|).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.lowTurn
lean.code:
noncomputable def lowTurn (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  angleAtom p α + angleAtom (t / q) γ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.StrictAngles
lean.code:
def StrictAngles (q h α β γ δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  α ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) ∧ β ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) ∧
    γ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) ∧ δ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) ∧
      (h / q) * Real.sin δ < 1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.nativeHalfClosure
lean.code:
noncomputable def nativeHalfClosure (p t q h l α β γ δ : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.sin α : ℂ) +
    ((Real.sin γ / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ) +
    ((Real.sin δ / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ + (γ + δ)) +
    (Real.sin β : ℂ) *
      unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ + (γ + δ) + highTurn q h l β δ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.highTurn
lean.code:
noncomputable def highTurn (q h l β δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  angleAtom (h / q) δ + angleAtom l β

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.seamLow
lean.code:
noncomputable def seamLow (p t q α β γ δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  β + δ + lowTurn p t q α γ - Real.pi

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.angleAtom
lean.code: noncomputable def angleAtom (a z : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.arcsin (a * Real.sin z)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.chord
lean.code:
noncomputable def chord (q α β γ δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sin (α + β) - Real.sin (γ + δ) / q

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.turnDefect
lean.code:
noncomputable def turnDefect (p t q h l α β γ δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (α + β) + (γ + δ) + lowTurn p t q α γ + highTurn q h l β δ -
    2 * Real.pi

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.seamHigh
lean.code:
noncomputable def seamHigh (q h l α β γ δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  α + γ + highTurn q h l β δ - Real.pi

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.splitHalfLengths
lean.code:
noncomputable def splitHalfLengths (q T : ℝ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) : Fin 4 → ℝ :=
  ![Real.sin (x 1), Real.sin (x 2) / q,
    Real.sin (T - x 2) / q, Real.sin (x 0 - x 1)]

blocks.label: lem:nfp_split_lengths
blocks.title: split coordinates and the physical walls
blocks.body:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item If $q\ne0$ and the four split angles
      $\alpha,S-\alpha,\gamma,T-\gamma$ lie in $(0,\pi/2)$, then
      $N(\operatorname{split}(x))=(E,D)$ evaluated at
      $(\alpha,S-\alpha,\gamma,T-\gamma)$.
    \item If $0<p<1$, $0<t<q$, $0<l<1$ and the split angles are strict,
      then $\operatorname{split}(x)$ is physical.
    \item Conversely, if $q>0$ and $L$ is physical, then $L=\operatorname{split}(x)$
      for strict angles, namely $\alpha=\arcsin L_0$, $\beta=\arcsin L_3$,
      $\gamma=\arcsin(qL_1)$, $\delta=\arcsin(qL_2)$, $S=\alpha+\beta$,
      $T=\gamma+\delta$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.nativeLengthPhysical_splitHalfLengths
lean.code:
theorem nativeLengthPhysical_splitHalfLengths {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2)) :
    NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l (splitHalfLengths q T x) := by
  have hsa := sin_mem_unit_of_acute ha.1
  have hsb := sin_mem_unit_of_acute ha.2.1
  have hsg := sin_mem_unit_of_acute ha.2.2.1
  have hsd := sin_mem_unit_of_acute ha.2.2.2.1
  refine ⟨?_, hsa.2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hsb.2⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hsa.1
    · exact div_pos hsg.1 hq
    · exact div_pos hsd.1 hq
    · exact hsb.1
  · exact endpoint_arg_lt_one hp hp1 ha.1.1 ha.1.2
  · change t * (Real.sin (x 2) / q) < 1
    rw [show t * (Real.sin (x 2) / q) = (t / q) * Real.sin (x 2) by ring]
    exact endpoint_arg_lt_one (div_pos ht hq) ((div_lt_one hq).mpr htq)
      ha.2.2.1.1 ha.2.2.1.2
  · change q * (Real.sin (x 2) / q) < 1
    simpa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hq)] using hsg.2
  · change q * (Real.sin (T - x 2) / q) < 1
    simpa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hq)] using hsd.2
  · change h * (Real.sin (T - x 2) / q) < 1
    convert ha.2.2.2.2 using 1
    ring
  · exact endpoint_arg_lt_one hl hl1 ha.2.1.1 ha.2.1.2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_splitHalfLengths_of_physical
lean.code:
theorem exists_splitHalfLengths_of_physical {p t q h l : ℝ} {L : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (hq : 0 < q) (hphysical : NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l L) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, ∃ x : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2) ∧
      splitHalfLengths q T x = L := by
  rcases hphysical with ⟨hpos, h0, _hp0, _ht1, hq1, hq2, hh2, _hl3, h3⟩
  have hqL1 := mul_pos hq (hpos 1)
  have hqL2 := mul_pos hq (hpos 2)
  have hangle {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (hz1 : z < 1) :
      Real.arcsin z ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) :=
    ⟨Real.arcsin_pos.mpr hz, Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.mpr hz1⟩
  have hs {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (hz1 : z < 1) : Real.sin (Real.arcsin z) = z :=
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hz1.le
  let T := Real.arcsin (q * L 1) + Real.arcsin (q * L 2)
  let x : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
    ![Real.arcsin (L 0) + Real.arcsin (L 3), Real.arcsin (L 0), Real.arcsin (q * L 1)]
  have ha : StrictAngles q h (Real.arcsin (L 0)) (Real.arcsin (L 3))
      (Real.arcsin (q * L 1)) (Real.arcsin (q * L 2)) := by
    refine ⟨hangle (hpos 0) h0, hangle (hpos 3) h3,
      hangle hqL1 hq1, hangle hqL2 hq2, ?_⟩
    rw [hs hqL2 hq2]
    have he : (h / q) * (q * L 2) = h * L 2 := by field_simp
    rwa [he]
  refine ⟨T, x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [x, T] using ha
  · funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hs (hpos 0) h0
    · change Real.sin (Real.arcsin (q * L 1)) / q = L 1
      rw [hs hqL1 hq1]
      field_simp
    · change Real.sin (Real.arcsin (q * L 1) + Real.arcsin (q * L 2) -
        Real.arcsin (q * L 1)) / q = L 2
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left, hs hqL2 hq2]
      field_simp
    · simpa [splitHalfLengths, x, T] using hs (hpos 3) h3

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths
lean.code:
theorem nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths
    {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hα : x 1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2))
    (hβ : x 0 - x 1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2))
    (hγ : x 2 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2))
    (hδ : T - x 2 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2)) :
    nativeLengthController p t q h l (splitHalfLengths q T x) =
      nativeSplitController p t q h l T x := by
  have hs (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2)) :
      Real.arcsin (Real.sin z) = z :=
    Real.arcsin_sin (by linarith [hz.1, Real.pi_pos]) hz.2.le
  have he (a z : ℝ) : a * (Real.sin z / q) = (a / q) * Real.sin z := by ring
  simp only [nativeLengthController, lengthTurns, splitHalfLengths,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val, nativeSplitController,
    nativeHalfClosure, turnDefect,
    lowTurn, highTurn, angleAtom]
  simp only [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hq, he, hs _ hα, hs _ hβ, hs _ hγ, hs _ hδ]
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · ring

blocks.tex:
(1) For an acute angle $\arcsin(\sin z)=z$.  Hence $\theta_0=\beta+\alpha$,
  $\theta_2=\arcsin(\sin\gamma)+\arcsin(\sin\delta)=\gamma+\delta$,
  $\theta_1=\arcsin(p\sin\alpha)+\arcsin((t/q)\sin\gamma)=\Lambda$ and
  $\theta_3=\Upsilon$; substituting into \cref{def:nfp_native_model} gives
  $E$ and $D$ term by term.

  (2) Positivity: sines of acute angles are in $(0,1)$ and $q>0$.  The walls
  $L_0<1$, $qL_1<1$, $qL_2<1$, $L_3<1$ are $\sin z<1$ for acute $z$; the
  wall $hL_2<1$ is the strict high wall $(h/q)\sin\delta<1$; and
  $pL_0=p\sin\alpha<1$, $tL_1=(t/q)\sin\gamma<1$, $lL_3=l\sin\beta<1$
  because the coefficients $p,t/q,l$ lie in $(0,1)$.

  (3) The five walls $L_0<1$, $qL_1<1$, $qL_2<1$, $L_3<1$ and positivity put
  the four arcsines in $(0,\pi/2)$, and
  $(h/q)\sin(\arcsin(qL_2))=hL_2<1$ is the strict high wall.  Then
  $\sin\alpha=L_0$, $\sin\gamma/q=L_1$, $\sin(T-\gamma)/q=\sin\delta/q=L_2$
  and $\sin(S-\alpha)=L_3$.  This is an exact inverse; no regularity is
  assumed.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_native_equations
blocks.title: native zeros are seam/chord zeros
blocks.body:
For all real angles, with $r=\sin(\gamma+\delta)/q$,
  \[
    E=u(-\beta)\bigl(\sin(\alpha+\beta)-r\,u(H)\bigr)
      +\sin\beta\;u(-(\alpha+\beta))\bigl(u(D)-1\bigr)\qquad\mathrm{(CI)}
  \]
  If $0\le p$, $0\le t$, $0<q$ and the angles are strict, then
  \[
    E=0\ \text{and}\ D=0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad M=0,\ H=0,\ K=0 .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.seamLow_add_seamHigh
lean.code:
theorem seamLow_add_seamHigh (p t q h l α β γ δ : ℝ) :
    seamLow p t q α β γ δ + seamHigh q h l α β γ δ =
      turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ := by
  unfold seamLow seamHigh turnDefect
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.native_zero_iff_of_strictAngles
lean.code:
theorem native_zero_iff_of_strictAngles {p t q h l α β γ δ : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h α β γ δ) :
    (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ = 0 ∧
      turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ = 0) ↔
    (chord q α β γ δ = 0 ∧ seamLow p t q α β γ δ = 0 ∧
      seamHigh q h l α β γ δ = 0) := by
  have hlow := seamLow_mem_Ioo_of_strictAngles hp ht hq ha
  have hsin : 0 < Real.sin (γ + δ) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith [ha.2.2.1.1, ha.2.2.2.1.1])
      (by linarith [ha.2.2.1.2, ha.2.2.2.1.2])
  exact native_zero_iff (ne_of_gt (div_pos hsin hq)) hlow.1 hlow.2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.seamLow_mem_Ioo_of_strictAngles
lean.code:
theorem seamLow_mem_Ioo_of_strictAngles {p t q h α β γ δ : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h α β γ δ) :
    seamLow p t q α β γ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi := by
  rcases ha with ⟨hα, hβ, hγ, hδ, _⟩
  have hsinα : 0 ≤ Real.sin α :=
    (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hα.1 (by linarith [hα.2, Real.pi_pos])).le
  have hsinγ : 0 ≤ Real.sin γ :=
    (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hγ.1 (by linarith [hγ.2, Real.pi_pos])).le
  have hA := Real.arcsin_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg hp hsinα)
  have hB := Real.arcsin_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg ht hq.le) hsinγ)
  have hA' := Real.arcsin_le_pi_div_two (p * Real.sin α)
  have hB' := Real.arcsin_le_pi_div_two ((t / q) * Real.sin γ)
  unfold seamLow lowTurn angleAtom
  constructor <;> linarith [hβ.1, hβ.2, hδ.1, hδ.2]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.nativeHalfClosure_eq
lean.code:
theorem nativeHalfClosure_eq (p t q h l α β γ δ : ℝ) :
    nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ =
      unitPhase (-β) *
        ((Real.sin (α + β) : ℂ) -
          ((Real.sin (γ + δ) / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * unitPhase (seamLow p t q α β γ δ)) +
      (Real.sin β : ℂ) * unitPhase (-(α + β)) *
        (unitPhase (turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) - 1) := by
  have hpair :
      ((Real.sin γ / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ) +
        ((Real.sin δ / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ + (γ + δ)) =
      ((Real.sin (γ + δ) / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ + δ) := by
    calc
      _ = ((Real.sin γ : ℂ) + (Real.sin δ : ℂ) * unitPhase (γ + δ)) *
          unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ) / (q : ℂ) := by
            rw [unitPhase_add]
            push_cast
            ring
      _ = (Real.sin (γ + δ) : ℂ) * unitPhase δ *
          unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ) / (q : ℂ) := by rw [sin_pair_phase]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [unitPhase_add]
        push_cast
        ring
  have hlast :
      unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ + (γ + δ) + highTurn q h l β δ) =
        unitPhase (-(α + β)) * unitPhase (turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) := by
    rw [← unitPhase_add]
    have heq : lowTurn p t q α γ + (γ + δ) + highTurn q h l β δ =
        (-(α + β) + turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ) + 2 * Real.pi := by
      unfold turnDefect
      ring
    rw [heq, unitPhase_add_two_pi]
  have hseam : unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ + δ) =
      -(unitPhase (-β) * unitPhase (seamLow p t q α β γ δ)) := by
    rw [← unitPhase_add]
    have heq : lowTurn p t q α γ + δ =
        (-β + seamLow p t q α β γ δ) + Real.pi := by
      unfold seamLow
      ring
    rw [heq, phase_add_pi]
  calc
    _ = (Real.sin α : ℂ) +
        (((Real.sin γ / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ) +
          ((Real.sin δ / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ + (γ + δ))) +
        (Real.sin β : ℂ) *
          unitPhase (lowTurn p t q α γ + (γ + δ) + highTurn q h l β δ) := by
      unfold nativeHalfClosure
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hpair, hlast, hseam]
      linear_combination sin_pair_phase_neg α β

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.native_zero_iff
lean.code:
theorem native_zero_iff {p t q h l α β γ δ : ℝ}
    (hr : Real.sin (γ + δ) / q ≠ 0)
    (hlo : -Real.pi < seamLow p t q α β γ δ)
    (hhi : seamLow p t q α β γ δ < Real.pi) :
    (nativeHalfClosure p t q h l α β γ δ = 0 ∧
      turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ = 0) ↔
    (chord q α β γ δ = 0 ∧ seamLow p t q α β γ δ = 0 ∧
      seamHigh q h l α β γ δ = 0) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hE, hT⟩
    rw [nativeHalfClosure_eq, hT, phase_zero, sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero] at hE
    have hphase : unitPhase (-β) ≠ 0 := by
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp hE).resolve_left hphase
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hz
    simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, unitPhase_im, zero_mul, add_zero, Complex.zero_im] at him
    have hsin : Real.sin (seamLow p t q α β γ δ) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp (by linarith :
        Real.sin (γ + δ) / q * Real.sin (seamLow p t q α β γ δ) = 0)).resolve_left hr
    have hH : seamLow p t q α β γ δ = 0 :=
      (Real.sin_eq_zero_iff_of_lt_of_lt hlo hhi).mp hsin
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re hz
    rw [hH, phase_zero, mul_one] at hre
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.zero_re] at hre
    refine ⟨hre, hH, ?_⟩
    have hs := seamLow_add_seamHigh p t q h l α β γ δ
    rw [hH, hT, zero_add] at hs
    exact hs
  · rintro ⟨hc, hH, hK⟩
    have hT : turnDefect p t q h l α β γ δ = 0 := by
      rw [← seamLow_add_seamHigh, hH, hK, add_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, hT⟩
    rw [nativeHalfClosure_eq, hH, hT, phase_zero, mul_one,
      sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero, ← Complex.ofReal_sub]
    change unitPhase (-β) * (chord q α β γ δ : ℂ) = 0
    rw [hc, Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero]

blocks.tex:
\emph{Identity.}  The middle two terms of $E$ combine by the elementary
  identity $\sin a+\sin b\,u(a+b)=\sin(a+b)\,u(b)$:
  \[
    \tfrac{\sin\gamma}{q}u(\Lambda)+\tfrac{\sin\delta}{q}u(\Lambda+\gamma+\delta)
    =r\,u(\Lambda+\delta).
  \]
  Since $\Lambda+\delta=-\beta+H+\pi$, this is $-r\,u(-\beta)u(H)$.  For the
  last term, $\Lambda+(\gamma+\delta)+\Upsilon=-(\alpha+\beta)+D+2\pi$, so
  $u(\cdot)=u(-(\alpha+\beta))u(D)$.  Finally the conjugate form
  $\sin\alpha+\sin\beta\,u(-(\alpha+\beta))=\sin(\alpha+\beta)u(-\beta)$ of
  the same elementary identity absorbs the first term and the
  $u(D)$-independent part of the last one.  The correction term
  $\sin\beta\,u(-(\alpha+\beta))(u(D)-1)$ is kept: the identity holds off the
  zero set, which is what allows it to be differentiated later
  (\cref{lem:nfp_closure_transfer}).

  \emph{Branch of the low seam.}  For strict angles, $\beta,\delta\in(0,\pi/2)$
  and both atoms of $\Lambda$ lie in $[0,\pi/2]$ because
  $p\sin\alpha\ge0$ and $(t/q)\sin\gamma\ge0$.  Hence
  $H=\beta+\delta+\Lambda-\pi\in(-\pi,\pi)$.  Also $\gamma+\delta\in(0,\pi)$,
  so $r=\sin(\gamma+\delta)/q>0$.

  \emph{Equivalence.}  If $E=0$ and $D=0$, $\mathrm{(CI)}$
  gives $u(-\beta)(\sin(\alpha+\beta)-r\,u(H))=0$, so
  $\sin(\alpha+\beta)=r\,u(H)$.  Its imaginary part is $r\sin H=0$; since
  $r\ne0$ and $H\in(-\pi,\pi)$, $H=0$.  Then the real part gives $M=0$, and
  $K=D-H=0$.  Conversely $H=K=0$ gives $D=H+K=0$, and then $E=u(-\beta)M=0$.
  The branch guard matters: without $H\in(-\pi,\pi)$ the equation
  $\sin H=0$ would also allow $H=\pm\pi$, which is not a zero of the
  original map.  The reduced equations are only an equivalent description of
  the zero set; the anchor produced later is always a zero of the original
  $N$.

blocks.title: first-pair flag
blocks.body:
For real $p,q,h,l$ put
  $\sigma(h,l)=\sqrt{(1-l^2)/(h^2-l^2)}$ and
  \[
    \Phi(p,q,h,l)=\arcsin p+\arcsin\bigl(q\,\sigma(h,l)\bigr)
      -\arcsin\sigma(h,l)-\frac\pi2
  \]
  with the principal arcsine.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.firstPairFlag
lean.code:
noncomputable def firstPairFlag (p q h l : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.arcsin p + Real.arcsin (q * firstPairSigma h l) -
    Real.arcsin (firstPairSigma h l) - Real.pi / 2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.firstPairSigma
lean.code:
noncomputable def firstPairSigma (h l : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  √((1 - l ^ 2) / (h ^ 2 - l ^ 2))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.firstPairFlag_guard_and_bound
lean.code:
theorem firstPairFlag_guard_and_bound {p q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h) (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l) :
    firstPairSigma h l < p ∧
      √(1 - p ^ 2) * √(1 - (firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2) ≤
        (q - p) * firstPairSigma h l := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hs1, _hsq, hhs⟩ := firstPairSigma_data (h := h) (by linarith) hl hl1
  exact arcsin_flag_guard_and_bound hp hp1 hs hs1
    ((mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hqh hs).trans hhs) hflag

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.arcsin_flag_one_lt_mul
lean.code:
theorem arcsin_flag_one_lt_mul {p q s : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (hqs : q * s < 1)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ Real.arcsin p + Real.arcsin (q * s) -
      Real.arcsin s - Real.pi / 2) : 1 < p * q := by
  obtain ⟨hsp, hbound⟩ := arcsin_flag_guard_and_bound hp hp1 hs hs1 hqs hflag
  have hpRad : 0 < 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsRad : 0 < 1 - s ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hr : 0 < √(1 - p ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpRad
  have hc : 0 < √(1 - s ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hsRad
  have hr2 := Real.sq_sqrt hpRad.le
  have hc2 := Real.sq_sqrt hsRad.le
  have hcomp : √(1 - p ^ 2) * s < p * √(1 - s ^ 2) := by
    have hsq : (√(1 - p ^ 2) * s) ^ 2 < (p * √(1 - s ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ => v * s ^ 2) hr2,
        congrArg (fun v : ℝ => p ^ 2 * v) hc2]
    exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (mul_pos hr hs).le (mul_pos hp hc).le).mp hsq
  have hstep := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcomp hr
  have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound hp.le
  have hmul : s < p * q * s := by
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ => v * s) hr2]
  exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ hs).mp (by simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hmul)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.firstPairFlag_square_bound
lean.code:
theorem firstPairFlag_square_bound {p q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h) (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l) :
    (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1) ≤ (1 - l ^ 2) * (q - p) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hs, _hs1, hsig, _hwall⟩ := firstPairSigma_data (h := h) (by linarith) hl hl1
  obtain ⟨_hguard, hbound⟩ := firstPairFlag_guard_and_bound hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  have hpRad : 0 ≤ 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsRad : 0 ≤ 1 - (firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hr2 := Real.sq_sqrt hpRad
  have hc2 := Real.sq_sqrt hsRad
  have hright : 0 ≤ (q - p) * firstPairSigma h l :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) hs.le
  have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) hright).mpr hbound
  have hpoly : (1 - p ^ 2) * (1 - (firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2) ≤
      (q - p) ^ 2 * (firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [mul_pow, hr2, hc2] using hsq
  have hden : 0 < h ^ 2 - l ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpoly hden.le
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ => (q - p) ^ 2 * v) hsig,
    congrArg (fun v : ℝ => (1 - p ^ 2) * v) hsig]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.arcsin_flag_guard_and_bound
lean.code:
theorem arcsin_flag_guard_and_bound {p q s : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (hqs : q * s < 1)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ Real.arcsin p + Real.arcsin (q * s) -
      Real.arcsin s - Real.pi / 2) :
    s < p ∧ √(1 - p ^ 2) * √(1 - s ^ 2) ≤ (q - p) * s := by
  have hP0 := Real.arcsin_pos.2 hp
  have hP1 := Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.2 hp1
  have hS0 := Real.arcsin_pos.2 hs
  have hS1 := Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.2 hs1
  have hQ1 := Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.2 hqs
  have hPS : Real.arcsin s < Real.arcsin p := by linarith
  have hsp : s < p := by
    by_contra h
    have := Real.arcsin_le_arcsin (le_of_not_gt h)
    linarith
  refine ⟨hsp, ?_⟩
  have hleft : Real.pi / 2 - Real.arcsin p + Real.arcsin s ∈
      Icc (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := by
    constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hright : Real.arcsin (q * s) ∈ Icc (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) :=
    ⟨Real.neg_pi_div_two_le_arcsin _, (Real.arcsin_le_pi_div_two _)⟩
  have hsin := Real.monotoneOn_sin hleft hright (by linarith)
  have hqs0 : 0 < q * s := by
    have : 0 < Real.arcsin (q * s) := by linarith
    exact Real.arcsin_pos.mp this
  rw [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_pi_div_two_sub, Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith : -1 ≤ p) hp1.le,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith : -1 ≤ s) hs1.le,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith : -1 ≤ q * s) hqs.le,
    Real.cos_arcsin, Real.cos_arcsin] at hsin
  nlinarith

lean.code:
theorem firstPairSigma_data {h l : ℝ} (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) :
    0 < firstPairSigma h l ∧ firstPairSigma h l < 1 ∧
      (firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - l ^ 2) = 1 - l ^ 2 ∧
      h * firstPairSigma h l < 1 := by
  have hnum : 0 < 1 - l ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hden : 0 < h ^ 2 - l ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hs : 0 < firstPairSigma h l := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hnum hden)
  have hs2 : (firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2 = (1 - l ^ 2) / (h ^ 2 - l ^ 2) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (div_pos hnum hden).le
  have hid : (firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - l ^ 2) = 1 - l ^ 2 := by
    rw [hs2]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hden)
  have hhs : h * firstPairSigma h l < 1 := by
    have hidentity : (1 - (h * firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - l ^ 2) =
        l ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - 1) := by
      nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ => h ^ 2 * v) hid]
    have hpos : 0 < l ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - 1) := mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hl) (by nlinarith)
    have hsq : 0 < 1 - (h * firstPairSigma h l) ^ 2 :=
      pos_of_mul_pos_left (hidentity.symm ▸ hpos) hden.le
    nlinarith [mul_pos (show 0 < h by linarith) hs]
  refine ⟨hs, ?_, hid, hhs⟩
  nlinarith

theorem firstPairFlag_one_lt_mul {p q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h) (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l) :
    1 < p * q := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hs1, _hsq, hhs⟩ := firstPairSigma_data (h := h) (by linarith) hl hl1
  exact arcsin_flag_one_lt_mul hp hp1 hs hs1
    ((mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hqh hs).trans hhs) hflag

\emph{Data of $s$.}  $1-l^2>0$ and $h^2-l^2>0$ give $s>0$ and the identity
  $s^2(h^2-l^2)=1-l^2$, whence $s<1$.  Multiplying the identity by $h^2$ gives
  $(1-(hs)^2)(h^2-l^2)=l^2(h^2-1)>0$, so $hs<1$, and then $qs<hs<1$.

  Write $P=\arcsin p$, $S=\arcsin s$, $Q=\arcsin(qs)$; all three are in
  $(0,\pi/2)$ (for $Q$ note $Q\ge\pi/2-P+S>0$ once (1) is known, and
  $qs<1$).  The flag reads $P+Q-S\ge\pi/2$.

  (1) Since $Q<\pi/2$, $P-S>0$, and $\arcsin$ is increasing, so $s<p$.

  (2) By (1), $\pi/2-P+S\in(0,\pi/2)$, and $Q\in[-\pi/2,\pi/2]$; the flag
  says $\pi/2-P+S\le Q$.  Both sides lie in the principal interval where
  $\sin$ is increasing, so
  $\sin(\pi/2-P+S)=\cos P\cos S+\sin P\sin S\le\sin Q$, i.e.
  $\sqrt{1-p^2}\sqrt{1-s^2}+ps\le qs$.  The branch justification is exactly
  this membership in $[-\pi/2,\pi/2]$; it is proved, not assumed.

  (3) Both sides of (2) are nonnegative ($q>1>p$), so squaring preserves the
  inequality: $(1-p^2)(1-s^2)\le(q-p)^2s^2$.  Multiply by $h^2-l^2>0$ and
  use $s^2(h^2-l^2)=1-l^2$, $(1-s^2)(h^2-l^2)=h^2-1$.

  (4) From $s<p$ we get $(1-p^2)s^2<p^2(1-s^2)$, i.e.\
  $\sqrt{1-p^2}\,s<p\sqrt{1-s^2}$.  Multiplying by $\sqrt{1-p^2}$ and using
  $p\cdot$(2):
  \[
    (1-p^2)s<p\sqrt{1-p^2}\sqrt{1-s^2}\le p(q-p)s ,
  \]
  so $s<pqs$ and $pq>1$.

$\sigma=\sigma(h,l)\ge0$ is a square root, so $t\sigma\le\sigma$ and
  $\arcsin(t\sigma)\le\arcsin\sigma$ by monotonicity of $\arcsin$ on $\RR$.
  Also $\arcsin p<\pi/2$.  Adding, $\Phi<0$.  No sign of $h$, $l$, and no
  positivity of the readings beyond $p<1$, $t\le1$ is used.

This section proves that every physical native zero is regular.  The
hypotheses are $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $0<t<q$, $1<q<h$; no flag, no bound
$pt<1$ and no ordering of $t$ and $p$ is used.  The theorem is applied to
the roots of both \cref{sec:nfp_pure} and \cref{sec:nfp_ordered}.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_angle_slopes
blocks.title: endpoint-atom slopes
blocks.body:
Let $z\in(0,\pi/2)$, $a>0$ and $a\sin z<1$ (automatic if $a<1$).  Then
  $\operatorname{atom}(a,\cdot)$ has derivative
  \[
    \operatorname{slope}(a,z)=\frac{a\cos z}{\sqrt{1-a^2\sin^2z}}>0
  \]
  at $z$.  If $a<1$ then $\operatorname{slope}(a,z)<1$ and
  $\operatorname{atom}(a,z)<z$; if $a>1$ then $\operatorname{slope}(a,z)>1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.endpointAtom_lt_angle
lean.code:
theorem endpointAtom_lt_angle {a z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hz : 0 < z) (hz' : z < Real.pi / 2) :
    Real.arcsin (a * Real.sin z) < z := by
  have harg : 0 < a * Real.sin z := mul_pos ha (sin_pos_of_acute hz hz')
  have hlt : a * Real.sin z < Real.sin z := by
    nlinarith [sin_pos_of_acute hz hz']
  have h := Real.arcsin_lt_arcsin (by linarith : -1 ≤ a * Real.sin z)
    hlt (Real.sin_le_one z)
  rwa [Real.arcsin_sin (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) hz'.le] at h

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.angleSlope_lt_one
lean.code:
theorem angleSlope_lt_one {a z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hz : 0 < z) (hz' : z < Real.pi / 2) :
    angleSlope a z < 1 := by
  have hwall := endpoint_arg_lt_one ha ha1 hz hz'
  have hrad := endpoint_radicand_pos ha hz hz' hwall
  have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hrad
  have hsquare := Real.sq_sqrt hrad.le
  have hnum : 0 < a * Real.cos z := mul_pos ha (cos_pos_of_acute hz hz')
  have htrig := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq z
  have ha2 : a ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hdiff : (a * Real.cos z) ^ 2 < 1 - (a * Real.sin z) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ => a ^ 2 * v) htrig]
  have hlt : a * Real.cos z < √(1 - (a * Real.sin z) ^ 2) := by

The chain rule for $\arcsin$ at an argument in $(0,1)$ gives the formula.
  Compare squares: $(a\cos z)^2-(1-a^2\sin^2z)=a^2-1$, using
  $\sin^2+\cos^2=1$.  So the numerator is below the (positive) denominator
  when $a<1$ and above it when $a>1$.  Finally $a\sin z<\sin z$ for $a<1$
  and $\arcsin(\sin z)=z$.

    (hsum : Real.pi < S + T) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hchord : Real.sin S = Real.sin T / q) : Real.pi / 2 < S := by
  by_contra h
  have hS2 : S ≤ Real.pi / 2 := le_of_not_gt h
  have hsin := Real.sin_lt_sin_of_lt_of_le_pi_div_two
    (show -(Real.pi / 2) ≤ Real.pi - T by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) hS2
    (show Real.pi - T < S by linarith)
  rw [Real.sin_pi_sub] at hsin
  have hpos := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hS hS'
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have heq : Real.sin S * q = Real.sin T := (eq_div_iff hq0).mp hchord

blocks.tex:
$H=0$ says $S+T-\pi=(\alpha-\operatorname{atom}(p,\alpha))
  +(\gamma-\operatorname{atom}(t/q,\gamma))$, and both deficits are positive
  by \cref{lem:nfp_angle_slopes} ($p<1$, $t/q<1$).  So $S+T>\pi$.  Now
  $S,T\in(0,\pi)$ and $M=0$ says $q\sin S=\sin T$.  If $S\le\pi/2$, then
  $-\pi/2\le\pi-T<S\le\pi/2$ and $\sin$ is increasing there, so
  $\sin T=\sin(\pi-T)<\sin S$.  But $\sin S>0$ and $q>1$ give
  $\sin T=q\sin S>\sin S$, a contradiction.  Hence $\pi/2<S<\pi$ and
  $\cos S<0$.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_split_rank
blocks.title: rank of the seam/chord chart
blocks.body:
Fix $T$ and let $\Sigma(x)=(M,H,K)$ in the coordinates $x=(S,\alpha,\gamma)$
  of \cref{def:nfp_split_model}.  Assume $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $0<t<q$,
  $0<q<h$ and strict angles at $x$.  With
  \[
    R=\cos S,\quad A=1-\operatorname{slope}(p,\alpha),\quad
    B=1-\operatorname{slope}(l,\beta),\quad
    C=1-\operatorname{slope}(t/q,\gamma),\quad
    G=\operatorname{slope}(h/q,\delta)-1,
  \]
  $\Sigma$ has derivative at $x$ given by the matrix
  \[
    D\Sigma(x)=\begin{pmatrix}R&0&0\\1&-A&-C\\1-B&B&-G\end{pmatrix},
    \qquad \det D\Sigma(x)=R\,(AG+BC).
  \]
  If moreover $1<q$ and $H=M=0$ at $x$, then $\det D\Sigma(x)<0$ and
  $D\Sigma(x)$ is surjective.

theorem controller_minor_neg {R A B C G : ℝ}
    (hR : R < 0) (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) :
    Matrix.det !![R, 0, 0; 1, -A, -C; 1 - B, B, -G] < 0 := by
  have hpos : 0 < A * G + B * C := add_pos (mul_pos hA hG) (mul_pos hB hC)
  have hdet : Matrix.det !![R, 0, 0; 1, -A, -C; 1 - B, B, -G] =
      R * (A * G + B * C) := by
    simp [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    ring
  rw [hdet]
  exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hR hpos

theorem fderiv_splitController_surjective {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hangles : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2))
    (hlow : seamLow p t q (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2) = 0)
    (hchord : chord q (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2) = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (splitController p t q h l T) x) := by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_splitController hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq0 hqh hangles).fderiv]
  have hcos := cos_first_sum_neg_of_root hp hp1 ht htq hq hangles hlow hchord
  have hcos' : Real.cos (x 0) < 0 := by simpa using hcos
  rcases hangles with ⟨hα, hβ, hγ, hδ, hwall⟩
  exact splitDifferential_surjective (ne_of_lt hcos')
    (lowDefect_derivative_pos hp hp1 hα.1 hα.2)
    (lowDefect_derivative_pos hl hl1 hβ.1 hβ.2)
    (lowDefect_derivative_pos (div_pos ht hq0) ((div_lt_one hq0).2 htq) hγ.1 hγ.2)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.splitDifferential_surjective
lean.code:
theorem splitDifferential_surjective {R A B C G : ℝ}
    (hR : R ≠ 0) (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) (hC : 0 < C) (hG : 0 < G) :
    Function.Surjective (splitDifferential R A B C G) := by
  have hD : A * G + B * C ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (add_pos (mul_pos hA hG) (mul_pos hB hC))
  intro y
  let u := y 0 / R
  let v := y 1 - u
  let w := y 2 - (1 - B) * u
  refine ⟨![u, (C * w - G * v) / (A * G + B * C),
    (-A * w - B * v) / (A * G + B * C)], ?_⟩
  rw [splitDifferential_apply]
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [u, v, w]
  all_goals field_simp
  all_goals nlinarith

lean.code:
theorem hasFDerivAt_splitController {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 0 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hangles : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2)) :
    HasFDerivAt (splitController p t q h l T)
      (splitDifferential (Real.cos (x 0))
        (1 - angleSlope p (x 1)) (1 - angleSlope l (x 0 - x 1))
        (1 - angleSlope (t / q) (x 2)) (angleSlope (h / q) (T - x 2) - 1)) x := by
  rcases hangles with ⟨hα, hβ, hγ, hδ, hwall⟩
  have h0 := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0 x
  have h1 := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 1 x
  have h2 := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 2 x
  have hpD := (hasDerivAt_angleDefect hp hp1 hα.1 hα.2).comp_hasFDerivAt x h1
  have htD := (hasDerivAt_angleDefect (div_pos ht hq) ((div_lt_one hq).2 htq)
    hγ.1 hγ.2).comp_hasFDerivAt x h2
  have hlD := (hasDerivAt_angleDefect hl hl1 hβ.1 hβ.2).comp_hasFDerivAt x (h0.sub h1)
  have hhD := (hasDerivAt_angleExcess ((one_lt_div hq).2 hqh)
    hδ.1 hδ.2 hwall).comp_hasFDerivAt x (h2.const_sub T)
  have hM := ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin (x 0)).comp_hasFDerivAt x h0).sub_const (Real.sin T / q)
  have hLow := (((h0.add_const T).sub_const Real.pi).sub hpD).sub htD
  have hHigh := (((h0.add_const T).sub_const Real.pi).sub hlD).add hhD
  unfold splitDifferential
  apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · convert hM using 1 <;> simp [splitController, chord]
  · convert hLow using 1
    · ext y
      simp [splitController, seamLow, lowTurn, angleDefect, Function.comp_def]
      ring
    · simp
  · convert hHigh using 1
    · ext y
      simp [splitController, seamHigh, highTurn, angleDefect, angleExcess, Function.comp_def]
      ring
    · ext v
      simp
      ring

blocks.tex:
\emph{Derivative.}  $M=\sin S-\sin T/q$ depends on $S$ only, with derivative
  $\cos S$.  Rewrite with deficits and excesses
  (\verb|seamLow_eq_defects|, \verb|seamHigh_eq_defect_excess|):
  \[
    H=S+T-\pi-(\alpha-\operatorname{atom}(p,\alpha))
      -(\gamma-\operatorname{atom}(t/q,\gamma)),
  \]
  \[
    K=S+T-\pi-(\beta-\operatorname{atom}(l,\beta))
      +(\operatorname{atom}(h/q,\delta)-\delta),
  \]
  with $\beta=S-\alpha$ and $\delta=T-\gamma$.  By
  \cref{lem:nfp_angle_slopes} each deficit has derivative $1-\operatorname{slope}$
  and the excess has derivative $\operatorname{slope}-1$ (the strict high wall
  $(h/q)\sin\delta<1$ is what makes the last atom differentiable).  The chain
  rule gives the rows $(1,-A,-C)$ for $H$ and $(1-B,B,-G)$ for $K$ (since
  $\partial\beta/\partial S=1$, $\partial\beta/\partial\alpha=-1$,
  $\partial\delta/\partial\gamma=-1$).  This is the Fréchet derivative of the
  actual map $\Sigma$, not an unattached symbolic matrix.

  \emph{Signs.}  By \cref{lem:nfp_angle_slopes}, $A,B,C>0$ ($p,l,t/q<1$)
  and $G>0$ ($h/q>1$).  At a root $R<0$ by \cref{lem:nfp_obtuse_first}.
  Expanding along the first row, $\det=R\det\begin{pmatrix}-A&-C\\ B&-G\end{pmatrix}
  =R(AG+BC)<0$.

  \emph{Explicit inverse.}  Given $y=(y_0,y_1,y_2)$ put $u=y_0/R$,
  $v=y_1-u$, $w=y_2-(1-B)u$; then
  \[
    x'=\Bigl(u,\ \frac{Cw-Gv}{AG+BC},\ \frac{-Aw-Bv}{AG+BC}\Bigr)
  \]
  satisfies $D\Sigma(x)x'=y$, using only $R\ne0$ and $AG+BC>0$.

theorem closureTargetLinearMap_eq_zero_iff {β r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (c : ℂ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    closureTargetLinearMap β r c x = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have ht : x 1 + x 2 = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd hx
    have hz := congrArg Prod.fst hx
    change unitPhase (-β) * ((x 0 : ℂ) - Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * (x 1 : ℂ)) +
      c * ((x 1 + x 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 at hz
    rw [ht, Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hz
    have hphase : unitPhase (-β) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have he := (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hphase
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re he
    have him := congrArg Complex.im he
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
      zero_mul, one_mul, sub_zero, mul_zero, Complex.zero_re] at hre
    simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,

theorem closureTargetLinearMap_surjective {β r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (c : ℂ) :
    Function.Surjective (closureTargetLinearMap β r c) := by
  rintro ⟨z, s⟩
  let v : ℂ := unitPhase β * (z - c * (s : ℂ))
  let x : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![v.re, -v.im / r, s + v.im / r]
  have hs : x 1 + x 2 = s := by
    dsimp [x]
    ring
  have hrx : r * (-v.im / r) = -v.im := by
    field_simp
  have hv : (x 0 : ℂ) - Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * (x 1 : ℂ) = v := by
    change (v.re : ℂ) - Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * ((-v.im / r : ℝ) : ℂ) = v
    calc
      _ = (v.re : ℂ) - Complex.I * ((r * (-v.im / r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = (v.re : ℂ) + (v.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        rw [hrx]
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = v := Complex.re_add_im v
  have hphase : unitPhase (-β) * unitPhase β = 1 := by
    rw [← unitPhase_add]
    simp [phase_zero]
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · change unitPhase (-β) * ((x 0 : ℂ) - Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * (x 1 : ℂ)) +
      c * ((x 1 + x 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = z
    rw [hv, hs]
    dsimp [v]
    rw [← mul_assoc, hphase, one_mul]
    ring
  · exact hs

theorem hasFDerivAt_nativeSplitController_of_split
    {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    {f' : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ)}
    (hf : HasFDerivAt (splitController p t q h l T) f' x)
    (hz : splitController p t q h l T x = 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (nativeSplitController p t q h l T)
      ((closureTargetLinearMap (x 0 - x 1) (Real.sin T / q)
        (Complex.I * (Real.sin (x 0 - x 1) : ℂ) *
          unitPhase (-(x 0)))).toContinuousLinearMap.comp f')
      x := by
  let f := splitController p t q h l T
  have h0 := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0 x
  have h1 := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (F' := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 1 x
  have hM := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).hasFDerivAt.comp x hf
  have hH := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 1).hasFDerivAt.comp x hf
  have hK := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 2).hasFDerivAt.comp x hf
  have hMC := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp x hM
  have hphase := hasFDerivAt_phase (h0.sub h1).neg
  have hLow := hasFDerivAt_phase hH
  have hTurn := hasFDerivAt_phase (hH.add hK)
  have hsin := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (x 0 - x 1)).comp_hasFDerivAt x (h0.sub h1)
  have hsinC := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp x hsin
  have hcoeff := hsinC.mul (hasFDerivAt_phase h0.neg)
  have hE := (hphase.mul (hMC.add ((hLow.const_sub 1).const_mul
    ((Real.sin T / q : ℝ) : ℂ)))).add (hcoeff.mul (hTurn.sub_const 1))
  have hprod := hE.prodMk (hH.add hK)
  have hfun : (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ =>
      (unitPhase (-(z 0 - z 1)) *
          ((f z 0 : ℂ) + ((Real.sin T / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * (1 - unitPhase (f z 1))) +
        (Real.sin (z 0 - z 1) : ℂ) * unitPhase (-(z 0)) *
          (unitPhase (f z 1 + f z 2) - 1), f z 1 + f z 2)) =
      nativeSplitController p t q h l T := by
    funext z
    apply Prod.ext
    · simp only [nativeSplitController, nativeHalfClosure_eq]
      have ht := seamLow_add_seamHigh p t q h l (z 1) (z 0 - z 1) (z 2) (T - z 2)
      simp only [f, splitController, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val, chord]
      rw [ht]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel]
      push_cast
      ring
    · exact seamLow_add_seamHigh p t q h l (z 1) (z 0 - z 1) (z 2) (T - z 2)
  change HasFDerivAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ =>
      (unitPhase (-(z 0 - z 1)) *
          ((f z 0 : ℂ) + ((Real.sin T / q : ℝ) : ℂ) * (1 - unitPhase (f z 1))) +
        (Real.sin (z 0 - z 1) : ℂ) * unitPhase (-(z 0)) *
          (unitPhase (f z 1 + f z 2) - 1), f z 1 + f z 2)) _ x at hprod
  rw [hfun] at hprod
  apply hprod.congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [closureTargetLinearMap, Function.comp_def, hz, unitPhase]
    ring
  · simp [closureTargetLinearMap]

blocks.tex:
By \cref{lem:nfp_native_equations} a strict zero of $\mathcal N$ has
  $M=H=K=0$.  Rewrite $\mathrm{(CI)}$ as an identity of
  functions of $x$, valid everywhere (with $\sin(\alpha+\beta)=M+r$,
  $D=H+K$, $r=\sin T/q$ constant):
  \[
    \mathcal N(x)=\Bigl(u(-\beta)\bigl(M+r(1-u(H))\bigr)
      +\sin\beta\,u(-S)\bigl(u(H+K)-1\bigr),\ H+K\Bigr).
  \]
  Differentiate at the zero.  The factors $u(-\beta)$ and
  $\sin\beta\,u(-S)$ are multiplied by expressions that vanish there, so
  their derivatives do not contribute, and $d\,u(H)=i\,dH$,
  $d\,u(H+K)=i(dH+dK)$ at $H=K=0$.  Hence
  $D\mathcal N(x)=\Lambda\circ D\Sigma(x)$ with
  \[
    \Lambda(dM,dH,dK)=\bigl(u(-\beta)(dM-i\,r\,dH)+c\,(dH+dK),\ dH+dK\bigr),
    \qquad c=i\sin\beta\,u(-S).
  \]
  The full-turn correction term produces the $c$-column; the equality of the
  zero sets alone would not transfer derivatives.

  $\Lambda$ is bijective when $r\ne0$, and here $r=\sin T/q>0$ because
  $T\in(0,\pi)$.  Kernel: $dH+dK=0$ forces $u(-\beta)(dM-i r\,dH)=0$, so
  $dM=0$ and $r\,dH=0$, hence $dH=dK=0$.  Explicit preimage of $(z,s)$: with
  $v=u(\beta)(z-cs)$ take $(dM,dH,dK)=(\Re v,\,-\Im v/r,\,s+\Im v/r)$.
  Therefore $D\mathcal N(x)$ is the composite of two surjections
  (\cref{lem:nfp_split_rank}).

theorem fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective
    {p t q h l T : ℝ} {x : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (ha : StrictAngles q h (x 1) (x 0 - x 1) (x 2) (T - x 2))
    (hzero : nativeSplitController p t q h l T x = 0) :
    Function.Surjective
      (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l) (splitHalfLengths q T x)) := by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hc0 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 0) x := (continuous_apply 0).continuousAt
  have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 1) x := (continuous_apply 1).continuousAt
  have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun z : Fin 3 → ℝ => z 2) x := (continuous_apply 2).continuousAt
  have heα := hc1.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.1.1 ha.1.2)
  have heβ := (hc0.sub hc1).eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.2.1.1 ha.2.1.2)
  have heγ := hc2.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.2.2.1.1 ha.2.2.1.2)
  have heδ := (hc2.const_sub T).eventually
    (Ioo_mem_nhds ha.2.2.2.1.1 ha.2.2.2.1.2)
  have he : (nativeLengthController p t q h l ∘ splitHalfLengths q T) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      nativeSplitController p t q h l T := by
    filter_upwards [heα, heβ, heγ, heδ] with z hα hβ hγ hδ
    exact nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths (ne_of_gt hq0) hα hβ hγ hδ
  have hdL := differentiableAt_nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths
    hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq0 hqh ha
  have hdS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (splitHalfLengths q T) x := by
    apply differentiableAt_pi.mpr
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [splitHalfLengths]
    all_goals fun_prop
  have hs := fderiv_nativeSplitController_surjective_of_native_zero
    hp hp1 hl hl1 ht htq hq hqh ha hzero
  rw [← he.fderiv_eq, fderiv_comp x hdL hdS] at hs
  intro y
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hs y
  exact ⟨fderiv ℝ (splitHalfLengths q T) x v, hv⟩

  have hsb := sin_mem_unit ha.2.1
  have hsg := sin_mem_unit ha.2.2.1
  have hsd := sin_mem_unit ha.2.2.2.1

    (Real.differentiableAt_arcsin.mpr ⟨by linarith [hw.1], ne_of_lt hw.2⟩).comp L hg
  have h0 := hd (g := fun z => z 0) (by fun_prop) (by simpa [L, splitHalfLengths] using hsa)
  have h3 := hd (g := fun z => z 3) (by fun_prop) (by simpa [L, splitHalfLengths] using hsb)

  unfold nativeLengthController lengthTurns unitPhase

blocks.tex:
By \cref{lem:nfp_split_lengths}(3) write $L=\operatorname{split}(x)$ with
  strict angles.  The four split angles are acute on a neighbourhood of $x$,
  so by \cref{lem:nfp_split_lengths}(1)
  $N\circ\operatorname{split}=\mathcal N$ on that neighbourhood; in
  particular $\mathcal N(x)=N(L)=0$, and by \cref{lem:nfp_closure_transfer}
  $D\mathcal N(x)$ is surjective.  The map $N$ is differentiable at $L$: each
  of its eight arcsine arguments lies in $(0,1)$ by the strict walls, and
  $\arcsin$ is differentiable away from $\pm1$.  $\operatorname{split}$ is
  smooth.  By the chain rule and locality of the derivative,
  \[
    D\mathcal N(x)=DN(L)\circ D\operatorname{split}(x).
  \]
  A composite that is surjective has surjective outer factor: every target
  is $DN(L)$ applied to $D\operatorname{split}(x)v$.  No inverse of the map
  from three split variables to four lengths is needed.

In this section the hypotheses are
\[
  0<p<1,\quad 0<t,\quad pt<1,\quad 0<l<1,\quad 1<q<h,\quad \Phi(p,q,h,l)\ge0 .
\]
The case $t\le p$ (including $t=p$) satisfies $pt\le p^2<1$; the flag may be
zero.  By \cref{lem:nfp_flag_bounds}, $pq>1$, so also $t<q$.  The root is
found in the $(\alpha,\gamma)$-plane near the corner $(\pi/2,0)$ of the
closed construction square.

blocks.body:
Let $P\subseteq\RR^2$ be open, $F$ continuous on $P$, $a_{\min}<a$ and
  $\mathrm{lo}<\mathrm{hi}$.  Assume $(a,y)\in P$ for every
  $y\in[\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi}]$, $F(a,\mathrm{lo})\le0<F(a,\mathrm{hi})$,
  and, if $F(a,\mathrm{lo})=0$, that $x\mapsto F(x,\mathrm{lo})$ has a
  positive derivative at $a$.  Then there are $x\in(a_{\min},a)$ and
  $y\in(\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi})$ with $(x,y)\in P$ and $F(x,y)=0$.

theorem eventually_lt_left_of_hasDerivAt_pos {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a d : ℝ}
    (hd : HasDerivAt f d a) (hdpos : 0 < d) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[<] a, f x < f a := by
  have hfilter : 𝓝[<] a ≤ 𝓝[≠] a :=
    nhdsWithin_mono a (fun x hx ↦ ne_of_lt hx)
  have hslope : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[<] a, 0 < slope f a x :=
    ((hd.tendsto_slope.mono_left hfilter).eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hdpos))
  filter_upwards [hslope, eventually_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hs hx
  have hxa : x < a := hx
  rw [slope_def_field] at hs
  have hm := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hs (sub_neg.mpr hxa)
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_lt hxa))] at hm
  exact sub_neg.mp hm

theorem exists_inward_zero_of_boundary_derivative
    {F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {P : ℝ → ℝ → Prop} {a amin lo hi : ℝ}
    (hamin : amin < a) (hlohi : lo < hi)
    (hopen : IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ | P z.1 z.2})
    (hphysical : ∀ y ∈ Icc lo hi, P a y)
    (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) {z : ℝ × ℝ | P z.1 z.2})
    (hleft : F a lo ≤ 0) (hright : 0 < F a hi)
    (hderiv : F a lo = 0 → ∃ d > 0, HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ F x lo) d a) :
    ∃ x ∈ Ioo amin a, ∃ y ∈ Ioo lo hi, P x y ∧ F x y = 0 := by
  apply exists_inward_zero hamin hlohi hopen hphysical hcontinuous ?_ hright
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hleft with hneg | heq

      (hcontinuous.continuousAt (hopen.mem_nhds
        (hphysical lo (left_mem_Icc.mpr hlohi.le)))).comp
          (continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const)
    exact (hc.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hneg)).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds

theorem exists_inward_zero
    {F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {P : ℝ → ℝ → Prop} {a amin lo hi : ℝ}
    (hamin : amin < a) (hlohi : lo < hi)
    (hopen : IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ | P z.1 z.2})
    (hphysical : ∀ y ∈ Icc lo hi, P a y)
    (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) {z : ℝ × ℝ | P z.1 z.2})
    (hleft : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[<] a, F x lo < 0)
    (hright : 0 < F a hi) :
    ∃ x ∈ Ioo amin a, ∃ y ∈ Ioo lo hi, P x y ∧ F x y = 0 := by
  have hstrip : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, ∀ y ∈ Icc lo hi, P x y :=
    isCompact_Icc.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
      (fun y hy ↦ hopen.mem_nhds (hphysical y hy))
  have hcontRight : ContinuousAt (fun x ↦ F x hi) a :=
    (hcontinuous.continuousAt (hopen.mem_nhds (hphysical hi (right_mem_Icc.mpr hlohi.le)))).comp
      (continuousAt_id.prodMk continuousAt_const)
  have hpositive : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, 0 < F x hi :=
    hcontRight.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hright)
  have hamin' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 a, amin < x := eventually_gt_nhds hamin
  let : NeBot (𝓝[<] a) := nhdsWithin_Iio_neBot (le_refl a)
  have hchoose : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[<] a,
      amin < x ∧ x < a ∧ F x lo < 0 ∧ 0 < F x hi ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Icc lo hi, P x y := by
    filter_upwards [hamin'.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      eventually_mem_nhdsWithin, hleft,
      hpositive.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
      hstrip.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with x hx0 hx1 hxlo hxhi hxP
    exact ⟨hx0, hx1, hxlo, hxhi, hxP⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx1, hxlo, hxhi, hxP⟩ := hchoose.exists
  have hcontSlice : ContinuousOn (F x) (Icc lo hi) :=
    hcontinuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
      (fun y hy ↦ hxP y hy)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyzero⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hlohi.le hcontSlice ⟨hxlo.le, hxhi.le⟩
  have hlo : lo < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hy.1 (by
    intro heq
    subst y
    linarith)
  have hhi : y < hi := lt_of_le_of_ne hy.2 (by
    intro heq
    subst y
    linarith)
  exact ⟨x, ⟨hx0, hx1⟩, y, ⟨hlo, hhi⟩, hxP y hy, hyzero⟩

\emph{Tube.}  $\{a\}\times[\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi}]$ is compact and
  contained in the open set $P$, so for all $x$ in a neighbourhood of $a$ the
  whole slice $\{x\}\times[\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi}]$ lies in $P$.

  \emph{Right endpoint.}  $F$ is continuous at $(a,\mathrm{hi})\in P$, so
  $F(x,\mathrm{hi})>0$ for $x$ near $a$.

  \emph{Left endpoint.}  If $F(a,\mathrm{lo})<0$, continuity gives
  $F(x,\mathrm{lo})<0$ for $x$ near $a$.  If $F(a,\mathrm{lo})=0$ and
  $d>0$ is the derivative, the difference quotients
  $(F(x,\mathrm{lo})-F(a,\mathrm{lo}))/(x-a)$ tend to $d$, so they are
  positive for $x<a$ close to $a$, and then
  $F(x,\mathrm{lo})<F(a,\mathrm{lo})=0$.  The derivative is in the
  coordinate $x$ itself: moving $x$ to the \emph{left} of $a$ lowers the
  value.

  \emph{Slice.}  The left punctured neighbourhood of $a$ is nontrivial, so
  one $x\in(a_{\min},a)$ satisfies all three properties.  On that slice
  $F(x,\cdot)$ is continuous on $[\mathrm{lo},\mathrm{hi}]$ (the slice lies
  in $P$), negative at $\mathrm{lo}$ and positive at $\mathrm{hi}$.  The
  intermediate value theorem gives $y$ with $F(x,y)=0$, and the strict
  endpoint signs force $\mathrm{lo}<y<\mathrm{hi}$.

blocks.label: def:nfp_interior_chart
blocks.title: the arctangent chart
blocks.body:
For $(\alpha,\gamma)$ put $\varphi=\Lambda(\alpha,\gamma)-\alpha$ and
  \[
    \mathsf D=q\cos\varphi-\cos\gamma,\qquad
    \mathsf N=\sin\gamma-q\sin\varphi,\qquad
    \delta=\arctan(\mathsf N/\mathsf D),\qquad
    \beta=\pi-\delta-\Lambda(\alpha,\gamma),
  \]
  and $\mathcal K(\alpha,\gamma)=K(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)$, the high seam
  along the chart.  The point is \emph{interior-physical} if
  \[
    \mathsf D>0,\qquad \mathsf N>0,\qquad \beta\in(0,\pi/2),\qquad
    (h/q)\sin\delta<1 .
  \]
  The two free angles $\alpha,\gamma$ are not constrained by this
  predicate: they may lie on the construction boundary $\alpha=\pi/2$ or
  $\gamma=0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorBeta
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorBeta (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi - interiorDelta p t q α γ - lowTurn p t q α γ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorD
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorD (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  q * Real.cos (lowTurn p t q α γ - α) - Real.cos γ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorDelta
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorDelta (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.arctan (interiorN p t q α γ / interiorD p t q α γ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.InteriorPhysical
lean.code:
def InteriorPhysical (p t q h α γ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < interiorD p t q α γ ∧ 0 < interiorN p t q α γ ∧
    interiorBeta p t q α γ ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2) ∧
    (h / q) * Real.sin (interiorDelta p t q α γ) < 1

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorHigh
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorHigh (p t q h l α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  seamHigh q h l α (interiorBeta p t q α γ) γ (interiorDelta p t q α γ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorN
lean.code:
noncomputable def interiorN (p t q α γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sin γ - q * Real.sin (lowTurn p t q α γ - α)

blocks.label: lem:nfp_interior_equations
blocks.title: the chart solves the low seam and the chord
blocks.body:
Along the chart $H=0$ identically, and $M=0$ wherever $\mathsf D\ne0$.
  If $\alpha,\gamma\in(0,\pi/2)$ and the point is interior-physical, the
  four angles $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta)$ are strict.  The
  interior-physical set is open and $\mathcal K$ is continuous on it.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.isOpen_interiorPhysical
lean.code:
theorem isOpen_interiorPhysical (p t q h : ℝ) :
    IsOpen {z : ℝ × ℝ | InteriorPhysical p t q h z.1 z.2} := by
  rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  intro z hz
  have hD := (continuous_interiorD p t q).continuousAt.eventually
    (eventually_gt_nhds hz.1)
  have hN := (continuous_interiorN p t q).continuousAt.eventually
    (eventually_gt_nhds hz.2.1)
  have hβ := continuousAt_interiorBeta (ne_of_gt hz.1)
  have hβ0 := hβ.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds hz.2.2.1.1)
  have hβ1 := hβ.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hz.2.2.1.2)
  have hwallcont : ContinuousAt
      (fun w : ℝ × ℝ ↦ (h / q) * Real.sin (interiorDelta p t q w.1 w.2)) z :=
    continuousAt_const.mul (Real.continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp
      (continuousAt_interiorDelta (ne_of_gt hz.1)))
  have hwall := hwallcont.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hz.2.2.2)
  filter_upwards [hD, hN, hβ0, hβ1, hwall] with w hwD hwN hwβ0 hwβ1 hwwall
  exact ⟨hwD, hwN, ⟨hwβ0, hwβ1⟩, hwwall⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.continuousOn_interiorHigh
lean.code:
theorem continuousOn_interiorHigh (p t q h l : ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (interiorHigh p t q h l))
      {z : ℝ × ℝ | InteriorPhysical p t q h z.1 z.2} :=
  continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt (fun _ hz ↦ continuousAt_interiorHigh (ne_of_gt hz.1))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorDelta_pos
lean.code:
theorem interiorDelta_pos {p t q α γ : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < interiorD p t q α γ) (hN : 0 < interiorN p t q α γ) :
    0 < interiorDelta p t q α γ :=
  Real.arctan_pos.mpr (div_pos hN hD)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interior_seamLow
lean.code:
theorem interior_seamLow (p t q α γ : ℝ) :
    seamLow p t q α (interiorBeta p t q α γ) γ
      (interiorDelta p t q α γ) = 0 := by
  unfold seamLow interiorBeta
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.strictAngles_of_interiorPhysical
lean.code:
theorem strictAngles_of_interiorPhysical {p t q h α γ : ℝ}
    (hα : α ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2)) (hγ : γ ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2))
    (hP : InteriorPhysical p t q h α γ) :
    StrictAngles q h α (interiorBeta p t q α γ) γ (interiorDelta p t q α γ) :=
  ⟨hα, hP.2.2.1, hγ,
    ⟨interiorDelta_pos hP.1 hP.2.1, interiorDelta_lt_pi_div_two ..⟩, hP.2.2.2⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interior_chord
lean.code:
theorem interior_chord {p t q α γ : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (hD : interiorD p t q α γ ≠ 0) :
    chord q α (interiorBeta p t q α γ) γ (interiorDelta p t q α γ) = 0 := by
  have hc := chord_eliminated (p := p) (t := t) (α := α) (γ := γ)
    (δ := interiorDelta p t q α γ) hq
  have hzero : interiorD p t q α γ * Real.sin (interiorDelta p t q α γ) -
      interiorN p t q α γ * Real.cos (interiorDelta p t q α γ) = 0 := by
    unfold interiorDelta
    rw [Real.sin_arctan, Real.cos_arctan]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hzero] at hc
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_left hq

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.chord_eliminated
lean.code:
theorem chord_eliminated {p t q α γ δ : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    q * chord q α (Real.pi - δ - lowTurn p t q α γ) γ δ =
      interiorD p t q α γ * Real.sin δ - interiorN p t q α γ * Real.cos δ := by
  unfold chord interiorD interiorN
  rw [show α + (Real.pi - δ - lowTurn p t q α γ) =
      Real.pi - (δ + (lowTurn p t q α γ - α)) by ring,
    Real.sin_pi_sub, Real.sin_add, Real.sin_add]
  field_simp
  ring

blocks.tex:
$H=\beta+\delta+\Lambda-\pi=0$ is the definition of $\beta$.  For the chord,
  $\alpha+\beta=\pi-(\delta+\varphi)$, so
  \[
    q\,M=q\sin(\delta+\varphi)-\sin(\gamma+\delta)
    =\mathsf D\sin\delta-\mathsf N\cos\delta
  \]
  by the addition formulas.  With $\delta=\arctan(\mathsf N/\mathsf D)$ one
  has $\sin\delta=(\mathsf N/\mathsf D)\cos\delta$, so
  $\mathsf D\sin\delta-\mathsf N\cos\delta=0$ when $\mathsf D\neq0$.
  If $\mathsf N,\mathsf D>0$ then $\delta\in(0,\pi/2)$; together with
  $\alpha,\gamma$ acute, $\beta$ acute and the high wall, the angles are
  strict.  $\mathsf D,\mathsf N,\Lambda$ are continuous; $\delta$, $\beta$
  and $\mathcal K$ are continuous where $\mathsf D\ne0$ (the arcsines are
  continuous on $\RR$); the four defining inequalities are strict, so the set
  is open.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_wall_chart
blocks.title: the chart on the wall
blocks.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<t$, $pt<1<pq$ and $\gamma\in[0,\pi/2]$.  On
  $\alpha=\pi/2$ the chart is given explicitly by
  \begin{align*}
    \mathsf N&=\sqrt{1-p^2}\sqrt{q^2-t^2\sin^2\gamma}+(1-pt)\sin\gamma,\\
    \mathsf D&=p\sqrt{q^2-t^2\sin^2\gamma}+t\sqrt{1-p^2}\sin\gamma-\cos\gamma,
  \end{align*}
  and $\mathsf N>0$, $\mathsf D>0$, $\delta\in(0,\pi/2)$,
  $\beta\in(0,\pi/2)$.  Consequently $(\pi/2,\gamma)$ is interior-physical as
  soon as the high wall $(h/q)\sin\delta(\pi/2,\gamma)<1$ holds.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wall_chord
lean.code:
lemma wall_chord {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    chord q (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q γ) γ (wallDelta p t q γ) = 0 := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hD := wallD_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  have hlow : wallBeta p t q γ = Real.pi -
      (wallDelta p t q γ + lowTurn p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ) := by
    simp only [wallBeta, lowTurn, angleAtom, Real.sin_pi_div_two, mul_one]
    ring
  have hzero : wallD p t q γ * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q γ) -
      wallN p t q γ * Real.cos (wallDelta p t q γ) = 0 := by
    unfold wallDelta
    rw [sin_arctan_div_pos hD, cos_arctan_div_pos hD]
    ring
  rw [wallD_eq_trig hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    wallN_eq_trig hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1] at hzero
  unfold chord
  rw [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two]
  simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
  rw [hlow, Real.cos_pi_sub, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add]
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hq.ne'
  field_simp
  nlinarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallD_eq_trig
lean.code:
lemma wallD_eq_trig {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    wallD p t q γ = q * Real.sin (lowTurn p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ) - Real.cos γ := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have ha := wall_arcsin_arg_mem hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  unfold lowTurn angleAtom wallD
  rw [Real.sin_pi_div_two, mul_one, Real.sin_add,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hp1.le, Real.cos_arcsin, Real.cos_arcsin,
    Real.sin_arcsin ha.1 ha.2, wall_sqrt_ratio hp hp1 ht hpt hpq]
  field_simp

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wall_radicand_pos
lean.code:
lemma wall_radicand_pos {p t q : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q) (γ : ℝ) :
    0 < q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2 := by
  have hq := wall_one_lt_q hp hp1 hpq
  have htq : t < q := (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ hp).mp (hpt.trans hpq)
  have hs : Real.sin γ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq γ, sq_nonneg (Real.cos γ)]
  have hm : t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 :=
    mul_le_of_le_one_right (sq_nonneg t) hs
  have hsq : t ^ 2 < q ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallDelta
lean.code:
noncomputable def wallDelta (p t q γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.arctan (wallN p t q γ / wallD p t q γ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallBeta_pos
lean.code:
lemma wallBeta_pos {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : 0 < wallBeta p t q γ := by
  by_contra hb
  have hbn : wallBeta p t q γ ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hb
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (wallBeta p t q) (Set.Icc 0 γ) :=
    (continuousOn_wallBeta hp hp1 ht hpt hpq).mono
      (fun _ hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.trans hγ1⟩)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' hγ0 hcont
    (show 0 ∈ Set.Icc (wallBeta p t q γ) (wallBeta p t q 0) from
      ⟨hbn, (wallBeta_zero_pos (t := t) (q := q) hp1).le⟩)
  exact wallBeta_ne_zero hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hx.1 (hx.2.trans hγ1) he

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorN_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorN_wall {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    interiorN p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ = wallN p t q γ := by
  unfold interiorN
  rw [Real.sin_sub_pi_div_two, wallN_eq_trig hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1]
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallBeta_ne_zero
lean.code:
lemma wallBeta_ne_zero {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : wallBeta p t q γ ≠ 0 := by
  intro hb
  have hc := wall_chord hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hq1 := wall_one_lt_q hp hp1 hpq
  unfold chord at hc
  rw [hb, add_zero, Real.sin_pi_div_two] at hc
  have he : Real.sin (γ + wallDelta p t q γ) = q := by
    apply (div_eq_one_iff_eq hq.ne').1
    linarith
  have hs := Real.sin_le_one (γ + wallDelta p t q γ)
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorPhysical_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorPhysical_wall {p t q h γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2)
    (hwall : (h / q) * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q γ) < 1) :
    InteriorPhysical p t q h (Real.pi / 2) γ := by
  unfold InteriorPhysical
  rw [interiorD_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorN_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorDelta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorBeta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1]
  exact ⟨wallD_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    wallN_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    ⟨wallBeta_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
      wallBeta_lt_pi_div_two hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1⟩, hwall⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallD
lean.code:
noncomputable def wallD (p t q γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  p * Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2) +
    t * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) * Real.sin γ - Real.cos γ

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallBeta_lt_pi_div_two
lean.code:
lemma wallBeta_lt_pi_div_two {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : wallBeta p t q γ < Real.pi / 2 := by
  have hδ0 := wallDelta_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  have hδ1 := wallDelta_lt_pi_div_two p t q γ
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hsγ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hγ0
    (hγ1.trans (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
  have hpangle := Real.arcsin_pos.2 hp
  have htangle : 0 ≤ Real.arcsin ((t / q) * Real.sin γ) :=
    Real.arcsin_nonneg.2 (mul_nonneg (div_pos ht hq).le hsγ)
  have hbpi : wallBeta p t q γ < Real.pi := by
    unfold wallBeta
    linarith
  have hs : 0 < Real.sin (γ + wallDelta p t q γ) :=
    Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hc := wall_chord hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  unfold chord at hc
  rw [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two] at hc
  simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] at hc
  have hcos : 0 < Real.cos (wallBeta p t q γ) := by
    have := div_pos hs hq
    linarith
  by_contra hb
  have := Real.cos_nonpos_of_pi_div_two_le_of_le (le_of_not_gt hb)
    (show wallBeta p t q γ ≤ Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallD_pos
lean.code:
lemma wallD_pos {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : 0 < wallD p t q γ := by
  have hR := wall_radicand_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq γ
  have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sin γ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hγ0
    (hγ1.trans (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
  have hpq2 : 1 < p ^ 2 * q ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p * q - 1)]
  have hpt2 : p ^ 2 * t ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hp ht]
  have hgap : Real.cos γ ^ 2 <
      (p * Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hR.le]
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq γ,
      mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1 - p ^ 2 * t ^ 2 by linarith) (sq_nonneg (Real.sin γ))]
  have hlead : Real.cos γ < p * Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - t ^ 2 * Real.sin γ ^ 2) := by
    have hh := mul_pos hp (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hR)
    nlinarith
  have hrest : 0 ≤ t * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) * Real.sin γ := by positivity
  unfold wallD
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallN_eq_trig
lean.code:
lemma wallN_eq_trig {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    wallN p t q γ = q * Real.cos (lowTurn p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ) + Real.sin γ := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have ha := wall_arcsin_arg_mem hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1
  unfold lowTurn angleAtom wallN
  rw [Real.sin_pi_div_two, mul_one, Real.cos_add,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hp1.le, Real.cos_arcsin, Real.cos_arcsin,
    Real.sin_arcsin ha.1 ha.2, wall_sqrt_ratio hp hp1 ht hpt hpq]
  field_simp
  ring

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorHigh_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorHigh_wall {p t q h l γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) γ =
      seamHigh q h l (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q γ) γ (wallDelta p t q γ) := by
  unfold interiorHigh
  rw [interiorDelta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1,
    interiorBeta_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallBeta
lean.code:
noncomputable def wallBeta (p t q γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi - wallDelta p t q γ - Real.arcsin p -
    Real.arcsin ((t / q) * Real.sin γ)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.interiorD_wall
lean.code:
theorem interiorD_wall {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) :
    interiorD p t q (Real.pi / 2) γ = wallD p t q γ := by
  unfold interiorD
  rw [Real.cos_sub_pi_div_two]
  exact (wallD_eq_trig hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ0 hγ1).symm

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.wallN_pos
lean.code:
lemma wallN_pos {p t q γ : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1) (hpq : 1 < p * q)
    (hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ Real.pi / 2) : 0 < wallN p t q γ := by
  have hU : 0 < 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hR := wall_radicand_pos hp hp1 ht hpt hpq γ
  have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sin γ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hγ0
    (hγ1.trans (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hU) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hR))
    (mul_nonneg (sub_pos.mpr hpt).le hs)

noncomputable def wallN (p t q γ : ℝ) : ℝ :=

deps.title: the chart solves the low seam and the chord
deps.label: lem:nfp_interior_equations

blocks.tex:
On the wall $\Lambda=\arcsin p+\arcsin((t/q)\sin\gamma)$ and
  $\varphi=\Lambda-\pi/2$, so $\mathsf D=q\sin\Lambda-\cos\gamma$ and
  $\mathsf N=\sin\gamma+q\cos\Lambda$.  Expanding $\sin\Lambda,\cos\Lambda$
  with $\cos\arcsin x=\sqrt{1-x^2}$ and
  $q\sqrt{1-(t/q)^2\sin^2\gamma}=\sqrt{q^2-t^2\sin^2\gamma}$ (the radicand is
  positive since $t<q$) gives the displayed formulas.

  $\mathsf N>0$ is clear from $p<1$, $pt<1$, $\sin\gamma\ge0$.  For
  $\mathsf D>0$ it suffices that $p\sqrt{q^2-t^2\sin^2\gamma}>\cos\gamma$;
  squaring, $p^2q^2-p^2t^2\sin^2\gamma>1-\sin^2\gamma$ holds because
  $p^2q^2>1$ and $p^2t^2<1$.  Then $\delta=\arctan(\mathsf N/\mathsf D)\in
  (0,\pi/2)$.

  For $\beta$: by \cref{lem:nfp_interior_equations} the chord vanishes on the
  wall, which at $\alpha=\pi/2$ reads $\cos\beta=\sin(\gamma+\delta)/q$.  If
  $\beta=0$ then $\sin(\gamma+\delta)=q>1$, impossible; at $\gamma=0$,
  $\beta(0)=\pi-\delta(0)-\arcsin p>0$ because both subtracted angles are
  below $\pi/2$; and $\beta$ is continuous on
  $[0,\pi/2]$, so the intermediate value theorem gives $\beta>0$ throughout.
  Since $\beta<\pi$ and $\cos\beta=\sin(\gamma+\delta)/q>0$
  ($0<\gamma+\delta<\pi$), also $\beta<\pi/2$.  Thus the only inequality of
  \cref{def:nfp_interior_chart} not automatic on the wall is the high wall.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_wall_initial
blocks.title: initial values at \texorpdfstring{$\gamma=0$}{gamma = 0}
blocks.body:
Let $0<p<1<pq$, $1<h$, $0<l<1$ and
  $(1-p^2)(h^2-1)\le(1-l^2)(q-p)^2$.  With $Z=\sqrt{q^2-2pq+1}$,
  \[
    \sin\delta(0)=\frac{q\sqrt{1-p^2}}Z,\qquad
    \sin\beta(0)=\frac{q-p}Z,
  \]
  the high wall holds strictly at $\gamma=0$, $(h/q)\sin\delta(0)<1$, and
  the high seam is weakly negative there, $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)\le0$.

      (q - p) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
  have hU : 0 ≤ 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hZ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (wall_initial_norm_pos (q := q) hp hp1)
  have hb : wallBeta p t q 0 = Real.pi - (wallDelta p t q 0 + Real.arcsin p) := by
    simp only [wallBeta, Real.sin_zero, mul_zero, Real.arcsin_zero, sub_zero]
    ring
  rw [hb, Real.sin_pi_sub, Real.sin_add, Real.cos_arcsin,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith) hp1.le,
    sin_wallDelta_zero hp hp1 hpq, cos_wallDelta_zero hp hp1 hpq]

      q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hU]

lemma wall_initial_high_nonpos {p t q h l : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hpq : 1 < p * q) (hh : 0 < h) (hl : 0 < l)
    (hflag : (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1) ≤ (1 - l ^ 2) * (q - p) ^ 2) :
    seamHigh q h l (Real.pi / 2) (wallBeta p t q 0) 0 (wallDelta p t q 0) ≤ 0 := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hq1 := wall_one_lt_q hp hp1 hpq
  have hqp : 0 < q - p := by linarith
  have hU : 0 ≤ 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hZ := wall_initial_norm_pos (q := q) hp hp1
  have hsZ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hZ
  have hx : 0 ≤ h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) :=
    by positivity
  have hy : 0 ≤ l * (q - p) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by positivity
  have hsq : (h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1)) ^ 2 +
      (l * (q - p) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, Real.sq_sqrt hZ.le]
    apply (div_le_one hZ).2
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hU]
    nlinarith [hflag]
  have hangle := arcsin_add_arcsin_le_half_pi hx hy hsq
  have hxEq : h / q * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q 0) =
      h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
    rw [sin_wallDelta_zero hp hp1 hpq]
    field_simp
  have hyEq : l * Real.sin (wallBeta p t q 0) =
      l * (q - p) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
    rw [sin_wallBeta_zero hp hp1 hpq, mul_div_assoc]
  unfold seamHigh highTurn angleAtom
  rw [hxEq, hyEq]
  linarith
