lean.code:
lemma wall_initial_hwall {p t q h l : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (hpq : 1 < p * q) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hflag : (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1) ≤ (1 - l ^ 2) * (q - p) ^ 2) :
    (h / q) * Real.sin (wallDelta p t q 0) < 1 := by
  have hq := wall_q_pos hp hpq
  have hU : 0 < 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hL : 0 < 1 - l ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hH : 0 < h ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hmargin : 0 < (1 - l ^ 2) *
      (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1 - h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2)) := by
    calc
      _ = ((1 - l ^ 2) * (q - p) ^ 2 - (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1)) +
          l ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1) := by ring
      _ > 0 := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sub_nonneg.mpr hflag) (by positivity)
  have hgap := pos_of_mul_pos_right hmargin hL.le
  have hZ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (wall_initial_norm_pos (q := q) hp hp1)
  have hlt : h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) < Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
    have hsU := Real.sq_sqrt hU.le
    have hsZ := Real.sq_sqrt (wall_initial_norm_pos (q := q) hp hp1).le
    have hprod : 0 ≤ h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) := by positivity
    nlinarith
  rw [sin_wallDelta_zero hp hp1 hpq]
  have heq : h / q * (q * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) /
      Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1)) =
      h * Real.sqrt (1 - p ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 - 2 * p * q + 1) := by
    field_simp
  rw [heq]
  exact (div_lt_one hZ).2 hlt

blocks.tex:
At $\gamma=0$: $\mathsf N=q\sqrt{1-p^2}$, $\mathsf D=pq-1>0$ and
  $\mathsf N^2+\mathsf D^2=Z^2$, which gives $\sin\delta(0)$ and
  $\cos\delta(0)=(pq-1)/Z$.  Since $\beta(0)=\pi-(\delta(0)+\arcsin p)$,
  $\sin\beta(0)=\sin\delta(0)\sqrt{1-p^2}+\cos\delta(0)\,p=(q-p)/Z$.

  \emph{High wall.}  $(h/q)\sin\delta(0)=h\sqrt{1-p^2}/Z<1$ is
  $h^2(1-p^2)<Z^2$.  Indeed
  \[
    (1-l^2)\bigl(Z^2-h^2(1-p^2)\bigr)
    =\bigl[(1-l^2)(q-p)^2-(1-p^2)(h^2-1)\bigr]+l^2(1-p^2)(h^2-1),
  \]
  the bracket is $\ge0$ by hypothesis and the last term is $>0$.  This is
  strict even when the flag bound is an equality.

  \emph{Seam.}  $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)=\pi/2+0+\arcsin x+\arcsin y-\pi$ with
  $x=h\sqrt{1-p^2}/Z$ and $y=l(q-p)/Z$, both $\ge0$.  Now
  $x^2+y^2\le1$ is $h^2(1-p^2)+l^2(q-p)^2\le(q-p)^2+1-p^2$, i.e.\ the
  hypothesis.  For $x,y\ge0$ with $x^2+y^2\le1$,
  $x\le\sqrt{1-y^2}$, so $\arcsin x\le\arcsin\sqrt{1-y^2}=\arccos y
  =\pi/2-\arcsin y$.  Hence $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)\le0$.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_first_wall
blocks.title: a positive endpoint before the first high wall
blocks.body:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item Let $b>0$ and $f,g$ continuous on $[0,b]$ with $f(0)<1$, $g(b)>0$
      and $g(x)>0$ whenever $f(x)=1$.  Then some $c\in(0,b)$ has $f<1$ on
      $[0,c]$ and $g(c)>0$.
    \item Let $0<p<1$, $0<t$, $pt<1<pq$, $h,l>0$ and
      $(h/q)\sin\delta(\pi/2,0)<1$.  Then there is
      $\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}\in(0,\pi/2)$ such that the high wall
      $(h/q)\sin\delta(\pi/2,\gamma)<1$ holds for every
      $\gamma\in[0,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}]$ and
      $\mathcal K(\pi/2,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}})>0$.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_positive_before_first_wall
lean.code:
lemma exists_positive_before_first_wall {f g : ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 b)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc 0 b))
    (hf0 : f 0 < 1) (hgb : 0 < g b)
    (hwall : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 b, f x = 1 → 0 < g x) :
    ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b, (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 c, f x < 1) ∧ 0 < g c := by
  have hex : ∃ e, 0 < e ∧ e ≤ b ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Ico 0 e, f x < 1) ∧ 0 < g e := by
    let s := Set.Icc 0 b ∩ f ⁻¹' ({1} : Set ℝ)
    have hsclosed : IsClosed s :=
      hf.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc isClosed_singleton
    have hscompact : IsCompact s :=
      isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset hsclosed Set.inter_subset_left
    by_cases hs : s.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hscompact.exists_isLeast hs
      have heb : e ∈ Set.Icc 0 b := he.1.1
      have hfe : f e = 1 := he.1.2
      have he0 : 0 < e := by
        by_contra hh
        have hez : e = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hh) heb.1
        rw [hez] at hfe
        linarith
      refine ⟨e, he0, heb.2, ?_, hwall e heb hfe⟩
      intro x hx
      by_contra hh
      have hfx : 1 ≤ f x := le_of_not_gt hh
      have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 x) :=
        hf.mono (fun _ hy => ⟨hy.1, hy.2.trans (hx.2.le.trans heb.2)⟩)
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hfz⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hx.1 hcont
        (show 1 ∈ Set.Icc (f 0) (f x) from ⟨hf0.le, hfx⟩)
      have hes : e ≤ z := he.2 ⟨⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans (hx.2.le.trans heb.2)⟩, hfz⟩
      linarith [hz.2, hx.2]
    · refine ⟨b, hb, le_rfl, ?_, hgb⟩
      intro x hx
      by_contra hh
      have hfx : 1 ≤ f x := le_of_not_gt hh
      have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 x) :=
        hf.mono (fun _ hy => ⟨hy.1, hy.2.trans hx.2.le⟩)
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hfz⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hx.1 hcont
        (show 1 ∈ Set.Icc (f 0) (f x) from ⟨hf0.le, hfx⟩)
      exact hs ⟨z, ⟨⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans hx.2.le⟩, hfz⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he0, heb, hpre, hge⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hnear⟩ := Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff.1
    (hg e ⟨he0.le, heb⟩) (g e) hge
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hce⟩ := exists_between
    (show max 0 (e - d) < e from max_lt_iff.2 ⟨he0, by linarith⟩)
  have hcpos : 0 < c := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hc0
  have hcb : c < b := hce.trans_le heb
  have hcd : dist c e < d := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_neg (sub_neg.2 hce)]
    have : e - d < c := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hc0
    linarith
  have hgc := hnear ⟨hcpos.le, hcb.le⟩ hcd
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hgc
  refine ⟨c, ⟨hcpos, hcb⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact hpre x ⟨hx.1, hx.2.trans_lt hce⟩
  · linarith [hgc.1]

blocks.tex:
(1) The set $Z_1=\{x\in[0,b]:f(x)=1\}$ is compact.  \emph{Case $Z_1\ne
  \varnothing$}: let $e=\min Z_1$.  Then $e>0$ since $f(0)<1$, and $f<1$ on
  $[0,e)$: a point $x<e$ with $f(x)\ge1$ would give, by the intermediate
  value theorem on $[0,x]$, an earlier point of $Z_1$.  By hypothesis
  $g(e)>0$.  \emph{Case $Z_1=\varnothing$}: put $e=b$; again $f<1$ on
  $[0,b)$ by the same argument, and $g(b)>0$.  In both cases $g$ is
  continuous at $e$, so $g>0$ on $(e-d,e]$ for some $d>0$; choose
  $c\in(\max(0,e-d),e)$.  Then $f<1$ on $[0,c]\subseteq[0,e)$ and $g(c)>0$.

  (2) Apply (1) on $[0,\pi/2]$ to $f(\gamma)=(h/q)\sin\delta(\pi/2,\gamma)$
  and $g(\gamma)=\mathcal K(\pi/2,\gamma)$, both continuous by
  \cref{lem:nfp_wall_chart}.  At a contact $f=1$ the high atom equals
  $\arcsin1=\pi/2$, so
  $g=\pi/2+\gamma+\pi/2+\arcsin(l\sin\beta)-\pi>0$ ($\beta$ acute).  At the
  right end $\gamma=\pi/2$,
  $g=\pi/2+\pi/2+\arcsin((h/q)\sin\delta)+\arcsin(l\sin\beta)-\pi>0$.
  So the hypotheses of (1) hold.  Both possibilities --- a first contact
  with the high wall, or no contact before $\pi/2$ --- are covered, and the
  retreat by continuity puts $\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}$ strictly before the
  contact.

theorem exists_physical_boundary_strip_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ht : 0 < t) (hpt : p * t < 1)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l) :
    ∃ γhi ∈ Ioo 0 (Real.pi / 2),
      (∀ γ ∈ Icc 0 γhi, InteriorPhysical p t q h (Real.pi / 2) γ) ∧
      interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) 0 ≤ 0 ∧
      0 < interiorHigh p t q h l (Real.pi / 2) γhi := by
  have hpq := firstPairFlag_one_lt_mul hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  have hsq := firstPairFlag_square_bound hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  have hh : 1 < h := hq.trans hqh
  have hinit := wall_initial_hwall (t := t) hp hp1 hpq hh hl hl1 hsq
  obtain ⟨γhi, hhi, hwall, hpos⟩ :=
    exists_wall_positive_endpoint hp hp1 ht hpt hpq (by linarith) hl hinit
  refine ⟨γhi, hhi, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro γ hγ
    exact interiorPhysical_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hγ.1 (hγ.2.trans hhi.2.le) (hwall γ hγ)
  · rw [interiorHigh_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq (le_refl 0) (by positivity)]
    exact wall_initial_high_nonpos hp hp1 hpq (by linarith) hl hsq
  · rwa [interiorHigh_wall hp hp1 ht hpt hpq hhi.1.le hhi.2.le]

deps.title: a positive endpoint before the first high wall
deps.label: lem:nfp_first_wall

blocks.tex:
By \cref{lem:nfp_flag_bounds} the flag gives $pq>1$ and the square bound
  $(1-p^2)(h^2-1)\le(1-l^2)(q-p)^2$; $h>q>1$.  So
  \cref{lem:nfp_wall_initial} gives the strict initial high wall and
  $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)\le0$, and \cref{lem:nfp_first_wall}(2) gives
  $\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}$ with the high wall on $[0,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}]$
  and $\mathcal K(\pi/2,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}})>0$.  On the wall
  $\alpha=\pi/2$ the interior chart and the wall chart coincide
  ($\mathsf D$, $\mathsf N$, $\delta$, $\beta$, $\mathcal K$), so by
  \cref{lem:nfp_wall_chart} each $(\pi/2,\gamma)$ is interior-physical.  The
  denominator $\mathsf D>0$ and the physical inequalities are conclusions,
  not side assumptions.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_boundary_derivative
blocks.title: the inward boundary derivative
blocks.body:
Let $0<p<1$, $0<q<h$, $0<l<1$ and let $(\pi/2,0)$ be interior-physical.
  Then $\alpha\mapsto\mathcal K(\alpha,0)$ has derivative
  \[
    \mathcal K'=1+\bigl(\operatorname{slope}(h/q,\delta)-\operatorname{slope}(l,\beta)\bigr)\,
    \delta'>1
  \]
  at $\alpha=\pi/2$, where $\delta'>0$ is the derivative of
  $\alpha\mapsto\delta(\alpha,0)$.

theorem exists_derivative_gt_one_interiorHigh_boundary {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hphysical : InteriorPhysical p t q h (Real.pi / 2) 0) :
    ∃ d > 1, HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorHigh p t q h l α 0) d (Real.pi / 2) := by
  obtain ⟨dδ, hdδ, hδD⟩ := exists_pos_derivative_interiorDelta_boundary hp hp1 hq
    hphysical.1 hphysical.2.1
  have hlow := hasDerivAt_lowTurn_boundary (t := t) (q := q) hp hp1
  have hβD : HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorBeta p t q α 0) (-dδ) (Real.pi / 2) := by
    convert (hδD.const_sub Real.pi).sub hlow using 1 <;> simp [interiorBeta]
    rfl
  have hδpos := interiorDelta_pos hphysical.1 hphysical.2.1
  have hδlt := interiorDelta_lt_pi_div_two p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0
  have hβ := hphysical.2.2.1
  have hwall := hphysical.2.2.2
  have hlowwall := endpoint_arg_lt_one hl hl1 hβ.1 hβ.2
  have hhighD := (hasDerivAt_angleAtom (div_pos (lt_trans hq hqh) hq)
    hδpos hδlt hwall).comp (Real.pi / 2) hδD
  have hlowD := (hasDerivAt_angleAtom hl hβ.1 hβ.2 hlowwall).comp (Real.pi / 2) hβD
  have hhighSlope := one_lt_angleSlope ((one_lt_div hq).2 hqh) hδpos hδlt hwall
  have hlowSlope := angleSlope_lt_one hl hl1 hβ.1 hβ.2
  refine ⟨1 + (angleSlope (h / q) (interiorDelta p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0) -
      angleSlope l (interiorBeta p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0)) * dδ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hlowSlope hhighSlope)) hdδ]
  · have hd := (((hasDerivAt_id (Real.pi / 2)).add_const 0).add
      (hhighD.add hlowD)).sub_const Real.pi
    convert hd using 1 <;> simp [interiorHigh, seamHigh, highTurn, Function.comp_def]
    ring

lean.code:
theorem hasDerivAt_lowTurn_boundary {p t q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => lowTurn p t q α 0) 0 (Real.pi / 2) := by
  have hs : HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => p * Real.sin α) 0 (Real.pi / 2) := by
    simpa using (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (Real.pi / 2)).const_mul p
  have ha : HasDerivAt Real.arcsin (1 / √(1 - p ^ 2)) (p * Real.sin (Real.pi / 2)) := by
    simpa using Real.hasDerivAt_arcsin (by linarith : p ≠ -1) (ne_of_lt hp1)
  have hd := ha.comp (Real.pi / 2) hs
  simpa [lowTurn, angleAtom, Function.comp_def] using hd

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_pos_derivative_interiorDelta_boundary
lean.code:
theorem exists_pos_derivative_interiorDelta_boundary {p t q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hD : 0 < interiorD p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0)
    (hN : 0 < interiorN p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0) :
    ∃ d > 0, HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorDelta p t q α 0) d (Real.pi / 2) := by
  have hrad : 0 < 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsqrt : 0 < √(1 - p ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hrad
  let D := interiorD p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0
  let N := interiorN p t q (Real.pi / 2) 0
  let d := (q * p * D - N * (-q * √(1 - p ^ 2))) / D ^ 2
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d, D, N]
    apply div_pos
    · nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hq hp) hD,
        mul_pos hN (mul_pos hq hsqrt)]
    · exact sq_pos_of_pos hD
  have hquot := (hasDerivAt_interiorN_boundary (t := t) (q := q) hp hp1).div
    (hasDerivAt_interiorD_boundary (t := t) (q := q) hp hp1) (ne_of_gt hD)
  have harctan := (Real.hasDerivAt_arctan (N / D)).comp (Real.pi / 2) hquot
  refine ⟨1 / (1 + (N / D) ^ 2) * d, mul_pos (by positivity) hd, ?_⟩
  simpa only [interiorDelta, D, N, d, Function.comp_def, Pi.div_apply] using harctan

theorem hasDerivAt_interiorN_boundary {p t q : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => interiorN p t q α 0)
      (q * p) (Real.pi / 2) := by

  have hd := (hsin.const_mul q).const_sub (Real.sin 0)
  simpa [interiorN, lowTurn, angleAtom, Real.cos_sub_pi_div_two,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith : -1 ≤ p) hp1.le, Function.comp_def, Pi.sub_apply] using hd

blocks.tex:
At $\gamma=0$, $\Lambda(\alpha,0)=\arcsin(p\sin\alpha)$ has derivative
  $p\cos\alpha/\sqrt{1-p^2\sin^2\alpha}=0$ at $\pi/2$.  With
  $\varphi=\Lambda-\alpha$ (so $\varphi'=-1$ and $\varphi=\arcsin p-\pi/2$
  there),
  $\mathsf D'=-q\sin\varphi\cdot\varphi'=-q\sqrt{1-p^2}$ and
  $\mathsf N'=-q\cos\varphi\cdot\varphi'=qp$.  Hence
  \[
    \delta'=\frac1{1+(\mathsf N/\mathsf D)^2}\cdot
      \frac{qp\,\mathsf D+q\sqrt{1-p^2}\,\mathsf N}{\mathsf D^2}>0,
  \]
  since $\mathsf N,\mathsf D>0$.  As $\beta=\pi-\delta-\Lambda$,
  $\beta'=-\delta'$.  Now $\mathcal K(\alpha,0)=\alpha+\operatorname{atom}(h/q,\delta)
  +\operatorname{atom}(l,\beta)-\pi$, and by \cref{lem:nfp_angle_slopes} (the
  high wall and acute angles are part of interior-physicality)
  $\mathcal K'=1+\operatorname{slope}(h/q,\delta)\delta'
  -\operatorname{slope}(l,\beta)\delta'$.  Since
  $\operatorname{slope}(h/q,\delta)>1>\operatorname{slope}(l,\beta)$ and
  $\delta'>0$, $\mathcal K'>1$.

  This is a derivative with respect to $\alpha$.  The inward direction is
  $\alpha$ \emph{decreasing}; a positive $\alpha$-derivative therefore makes
  $\mathcal K(\alpha,0)$ strictly smaller than $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)$ for
  $\alpha$ slightly below $\pi/2$.  This is the sign used when
  $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)=0$, which happens exactly when the square flag bound
  is an equality.

Let $0<p<1$, $0<t$, $pt<1$, $0<l<1$, $1<q<h$ and $\Phi(p,q,h,l)\ge0$.

  $0<t<p$ and for $t=p$, with a zero flag allowed.

deps.label: lem:nfp_interior_equations

blocks.tex:
Take $\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}$ from \cref{lem:nfp_wall_strip}.  Apply
  \cref{lem:nfp_compact_boundary_ivt} with $F=\mathcal K$, $P$ the
  interior-physical set (open by \cref{lem:nfp_interior_equations}),
  $a=\pi/2$, $a_{\min}=0$, $\mathrm{lo}=0$, $\mathrm{hi}=\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}}$.
  The strip hypothesis and the signs $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)\le0<
  \mathcal K(\pi/2,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}})$ come from
  \cref{lem:nfp_wall_strip}.  If $\mathcal K(\pi/2,0)=0$, the positive
  derivative comes from \cref{lem:nfp_boundary_derivative} (its hypotheses
  hold because $(\pi/2,0)$ is in the strip).  We obtain
  $\alpha\in(0,\pi/2)$ and $\gamma\in(0,\gamma_{\mathrm{hi}})\subset(0,\pi/2)$,
  interior-physical, with $\mathcal K(\alpha,\gamma)=0$.

  Put $\beta,\delta$ from the chart.  By \cref{lem:nfp_interior_equations}
  the angles are strict, $H=0$ and $M=0$ (as $\mathsf D>0$), and $K=0$ by
  construction.  \Cref{lem:nfp_native_equations} (with $p,t\ge0$, $q>0$)
  turns this into $E=0$ and $D=0$.

  If $0<t\le p$ then $pt\le p^2<1$, so both the reversed case $t<p$ and the
  matched case $t=p$ are instances; no limiting argument or separate scalar
  producer is involved.  The root is produced directly from the flag: there is
  no continuation path, no assumed strict sign at the boundary, and no
  assumed nondegeneracy.

    (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)

      Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (nativeLengthController p t q h l) L) := by

    exists_native_zero_of_firstPairFlag_of_product_lt_one hp hp1 ht hpt hl hl1 hq hqh hflag

  have hpq := firstPairFlag_one_lt_mul hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag

    simpa [nativeSplitController, x, T] using hz
  have hphysical := nativeLengthPhysical_splitHalfLengths hp hp1 ht htq hl hl1 hq0 ha'
  have hzero : nativeLengthController p t q h l (splitHalfLengths q T x) = 0 := by
    rw [nativeLengthController_splitHalfLengths (ne_of_gt hq0)
      ha'.1 ha'.2.1 ha'.2.2.1 ha'.2.2.2.1]
    exact hsplit
  exact ⟨splitHalfLengths q T x, hphysical, hzero,
    fderiv_nativeLengthController_surjective_of_physical hp hp1 ht htq hl hl1 hq hqh
      hphysical hzero⟩

Take the strict root of \cref{thm:nfp_pure_root} and set $T=\gamma+\delta$,
  $x=(\alpha+\beta,\alpha,\gamma)$, $L=\operatorname{split}(x)$.  By
  \cref{lem:nfp_flag_bounds} $pq>1$, and with $pt<1$ this gives $t<q$.  So
  \cref{lem:nfp_split_lengths}(2) makes $L$ physical and
  \cref{lem:nfp_split_lengths}(1) gives $N(L)=(E,D)=0$.
  \Cref{thm:nfp_native_rank} gives surjectivity.  For $t\le p$ use
  $pt\le p^2<1$.

In this section
\[
  0<p<1,\quad 0<l<1,\quad p<t<q,\quad 1<q<h,\quad
  \Phi(p,q,h,l)\ge0,\quad \Phi(p,t,q,l)<0 .
\]
Neither $t<1$ nor $pt<1$ is assumed.  The strict predecessor flag
$\Phi(p,t,q,l)<0$ is used in addition to the current flag.  The root is a
point of an \emph{orthogonal core} family on which the two pure turns and the
real turn are automatically correct, selected by a zero of the two mixed
residuals.

blocks.title: The orthogonal core and the residuals

blocks.label: lem:nfp_ordered_core
blocks.title: the orthogonal core
blocks.body:
For $0<u,v<1<q$ let $d=\sqrt{q^2-u^2v^2}$ and let $A,B,C,D$ be the sides
  of the orthogonal quadrilateral with curvatures $(1,u,q,v)$
  (\cref{def:n4c_delta}; $\Delta=q^2-u^2v^2$):
  \[
    \frac A2=\frac{\sqrt{q^2-v^2}}d,\quad
    \frac B2=\frac{\sqrt{1-v^2}}d,\quad
    \frac C2=\frac{\sqrt{1-u^2}}d,\quad
    \frac D2=\frac{\sqrt{q^2-u^2}}d .
  \]
  All four are positive, and the length vector $(A,B,C,D)$ is a strict
  moderate-arc development of the curvature word $(1,u,q,v)$ that closes
  exactly with real total turn $2\pi$.

lean.code:
theorem r_core_side_half_diagonal_squares {k u q v : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hv : 0 < v)
    (huk : u < k) (huq : u < q) (hvk : v < k) (hvq : v < q) :
    rCoreSideA k u q v ^ 2 =
        rCoreHalfDiagonalA k u q v ^ 2 + rCoreHalfDiagonalB k u q v ^ 2 ∧
      rCoreSideB k u q v ^ 2 =
        rCoreHalfDiagonalB k u q v ^ 2 + rCoreHalfDiagonalC k u q v ^ 2 ∧
      rCoreSideC k u q v ^ 2 =
        rCoreHalfDiagonalC k u q v ^ 2 + rCoreHalfDiagonalD k u q v ^ 2 ∧
      rCoreSideD k u q v ^ 2 =
        rCoreHalfDiagonalD k u q v ^ 2 + rCoreHalfDiagonalA k u q v ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hD⟩ :=
    r_core_sides_pos hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hDelta := orthogonal_delta_pos_of_strict_alternation
    hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hqv := square_sub_pos hv hvq
  have hkv := square_sub_pos hv hvk
  have hku := square_sub_pos hu huk
  have hqu := square_sub_pos hu huq
  have hAroot := r_core_side_a_sq hDelta.le hqv.le
  have hBroot := r_core_side_b_sq hDelta.le hkv.le
  have hCroot := r_core_side_c_sq hDelta.le hku.le
  have hDroot := r_core_side_d_sq hDelta.le hqu.le
  have hasq : rCoreHalfDiagonalA k u q v ^ 2 =
      k ^ 2 * rCoreSideA k u q v ^ 2 * rCoreSideD k u q v ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (k * rCoreSideA k u q v * rCoreSideD k u q v / 2) ^ 2 = _
    ring
  have hbsq : rCoreHalfDiagonalB k u q v ^ 2 =
      u ^ 2 * rCoreSideA k u q v ^ 2 * rCoreSideB k u q v ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (u * rCoreSideA k u q v * rCoreSideB k u q v / 2) ^ 2 = _
    ring
  have hcsq : rCoreHalfDiagonalC k u q v ^ 2 =
      q ^ 2 * rCoreSideB k u q v ^ 2 * rCoreSideC k u q v ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (q * rCoreSideB k u q v * rCoreSideC k u q v / 2) ^ 2 = _
    ring
  have hdsq : rCoreHalfDiagonalD k u q v ^ 2 =
      v ^ 2 * rCoreSideC k u q v ^ 2 * rCoreSideD k u q v ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (v * rCoreSideC k u q v * rCoreSideD k u q v / 2) ^ 2 = _
    ring
  constructor
  · rw [hAroot, hasq, hbsq, hAroot, hBroot, hDroot]
    exact orthogonalA2_identity hDelta.ne'
  · constructor
    · rw [hBroot, hbsq, hcsq, hAroot, hBroot, hCroot]
      exact orthogonalB2_identity hDelta.ne'
    · constructor
      · rw [hCroot, hcsq, hdsq, hBroot, hCroot, hDroot]
        exact orthogonalC2_identity hDelta.ne'
      · rw [hDroot, hdsq, hasq, hAroot, hCroot, hDroot]
        exact orthogonalD2_identity hDelta.ne'

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_core_realization_data
lean.code:
theorem r_core_realization_data {k u q v : ℝ}
    (hk : 0 < k) (hu : 0 < u) (hq : 0 < q) (hv : 0 < v)
    (huk : u < k) (huq : u < q) (hvk : v < k) (hvq : v < q) :
    ModerateArc 0 (fourProfile k u q v)
        (fourProfile (rCoreSideA k u q v) (rCoreSideB k u q v)
          (rCoreSideC k u q v) (rCoreSideD k u q v)) ∧
      closureGap (fourProfile k u q v)
          (fourProfile (rCoreSideA k u q v) (rCoreSideB k u q v)
            (rCoreSideC k u q v) (rCoreSideD k u q v)) = 0 ∧
      turningSum (fourProfile k u q v)
          (fourProfile (rCoreSideA k u q v) (rCoreSideB k u q v)
            (rCoreSideC k u q v) (rCoreSideD k u q v)) = 2 * Real.pi ∧
      IsSimplePolygon (polygonR2 (fourProfile k u q v)
        (fourProfile (rCoreSideA k u q v) (rCoreSideB k u q v)
          (rCoreSideC k u q v) (rCoreSideD k u q v))) := by
  let A := rCoreSideA k u q v
  let B := rCoreSideB k u q v
  let C := rCoreSideC k u q v
  let D := rCoreSideD k u q v
  let a := rCoreHalfDiagonalA k u q v
  let b := rCoreHalfDiagonalB k u q v
  let c := rCoreHalfDiagonalC k u q v
  let d := rCoreHalfDiagonalD k u q v
  have hDelta := orthogonal_delta_pos_of_strict_alternation
    hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hqv := square_sub_pos hv hvq
  have hkv := square_sub_pos hv hvk
  have hku := square_sub_pos hu huk
  have hqu := square_sub_pos hu huq
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hD⟩ : 0 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧ 0 < C ∧ 0 < D := by
    simpa only [A, B, C, D] using
      r_core_sides_pos hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 0 < c ∧ 0 < d := by
    simpa only [a, b, c, d] using
      r_core_half_diagonals_pos hk hu hq hv huk huq hvk hvq
  have hAroot : A ^ 2 = orthogonalA2 k u q v := by
    simpa only [A] using r_core_side_a_sq hDelta.le hqv.le
  have hBroot : B ^ 2 = orthogonalB2 k u q v := by
    simpa only [B] using r_core_side_b_sq hDelta.le hkv.le
  have hCroot : C ^ 2 = orthogonalC2 k u q v := by
    simpa only [C] using r_core_side_c_sq hDelta.le hku.le
  have hDroot : D ^ 2 = orthogonalD2 k u q v := by
    simpa only [D] using r_core_side_d_sq hDelta.le hqu.le
  have hasq : a ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * A ^ 2 * D ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (k * A * D / 2) ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * A ^ 2 * D ^ 2 / 4
    ring
  have hbsq : b ^ 2 = u ^ 2 * A ^ 2 * B ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (u * A * B / 2) ^ 2 = u ^ 2 * A ^ 2 * B ^ 2 / 4
    ring
  have hcsq : c ^ 2 = q ^ 2 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (q * B * C / 2) ^ 2 = q ^ 2 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 / 4
    ring
  have hdsq : d ^ 2 = v ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * D ^ 2 / 4 := by
    change (v * C * D / 2) ^ 2 = v ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * D ^ 2 / 4
    ring
  have hAsq : A ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    rw [hAroot, hasq, hbsq, hAroot, hBroot, hDroot]
    exact orthogonalA2_identity hDelta.ne'
  have hBsq : B ^ 2 = b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by
    rw [hBroot, hbsq, hcsq, hAroot, hBroot, hCroot]
  -- … (truncated)

deps.title: the orthogonal quadrilateral is a moderate development
deps.label: thm:n4c_realization_data

blocks.tex:
The hypotheses give the strict alternation $u<1$, $u<q$, $v<1$, $v<q$, so
  $\Delta=(q-uv)(q+uv)>0$ and each side is positive.  The side-square
  identities of \cref{lem:n4c_identityA}, \cref{lem:n4c_identityB}, \cref{lem:n4c_identityC} and \cref{lem:n4c_identityD}
  show that $A,B,C,D$ are the hypotenuses of four right triangles with legs
  the half-diagonals $a=AD/2$, $b=uAB/2$, $c=qBC/2$, $d'=vCD/2$ (with the
  curvature $1$ at vertex $0$), and the curvature at each vertex is recovered
  as $2\cdot(\text{half-diagonal})/(\text{product of adjacent sides})$.
  \Cref{thm:n4c_realization_data} is then exactly the claimed moderate-arc
  closure with total turn $2\pi$.  This is the full coherent realization, not
  merely a Menger-curvature statement.  The half-side formulas are the
  definitions evaluated at $k=1$.

blocks.label: def:nfp_ordered_residual
blocks.title: the two mixed residuals
blocks.body:
For real $p,t,q,h,l$ and $(u,v)\in\RR^2$ put $d=\sqrt{q^2-u^2v^2}$ and
  define the four scalar factors
  \[
    \frac A2=\frac{\sqrt{q^2-v^2}}d,\quad
    \frac B2=\frac{\sqrt{1-v^2}}d,\quad
    \frac C2=\frac{\sqrt{1-u^2}}d,\quad
    \frac D2=\frac{\sqrt{q^2-u^2}}d
  \]
  (all functions of $(u,q,v)$).  The two \emph{mixed residuals} are
  \begin{align*}
    R_1(u,v)&=\arcsin\bigl(p\tfrac A2\bigr)+\arcsin\bigl(t\tfrac B2\bigr)
      -\arcsin\bigl(u\tfrac A2\bigr)-\arcsin\bigl(u\tfrac B2\bigr),\\
    R_3(u,v)&=\arcsin\bigl(h\tfrac C2\bigr)+\arcsin\bigl(l\tfrac D2\bigr)
      -\arcsin\bigl(v\tfrac C2\bigr)-\arcsin\bigl(v\tfrac D2\bigr),
  \end{align*}
  and $\mathcal R(u,v)=R_1+iR_3\in\CC$.  The \emph{core half-lengths} are
  $L^{\mathrm{core}}(u,v)=(A/2,B/2,C/2,D/2)$, the cyclic vector of halved
  orthogonal-core side formulas at first curvature $1$ (the same total
  formulas whose geometric properties for $q>1$ are
  \cref{lem:nfp_ordered_core}; no such property is part of this
  definition).  These identifications hold literally:
  $R_1$ and $R_3$ equal the displayed four-arcsine expressions with $A/2$,
  $B/2$, $C/2$, $D/2$ replaced by the halved core sides at $k=1$.

    rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2, rCoreSideD 1 u q v / 2]

noncomputable def rResidualMap (p t q h l : ℝ) (z : ℝ × ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (rResidualOne p t q z.1 z.2 : ℂ) +
    (rResidualThree q h l z.1 z.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.rResidualOne
lean.code:
noncomputable def rResidualOne (p t q u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  let a := √(q ^ 2 - v ^ 2) / d
  let b := √(1 - v ^ 2) / d
  Real.arcsin (p * a) + Real.arcsin (t * b) -
    Real.arcsin (u * a) - Real.arcsin (u * b)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.rResidualThree
lean.code:
noncomputable def rResidualThree (q h l u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  let c := √(1 - u ^ 2) / d
  let e := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2) / d
  Real.arcsin (h * c) + Real.arcsin (l * e) -
    Real.arcsin (v * c) - Real.arcsin (v * e)

lean.code:
theorem r_residual_three_eq_core_sides (q h l u v : ℝ) :
    rResidualThree q h l u v =
      Real.arcsin (h * (rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2)) +
        Real.arcsin (l * (rCoreSideD 1 u q v / 2)) -
          Real.arcsin (v * (rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2)) -
            Real.arcsin (v * (rCoreSideD 1 u q v / 2)) := by
  simp only [r_core_side_c_half_at_one, r_core_side_d_half_at_one]
  rfl

lean.code:
theorem r_residual_one_eq_core_sides (p t q u v : ℝ) :
    rResidualOne p t q u v =
      Real.arcsin (p * (rCoreSideA 1 u q v / 2)) +
        Real.arcsin (t * (rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2)) -
          Real.arcsin (u * (rCoreSideA 1 u q v / 2)) -
            Real.arcsin (u * (rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2)) := by
  simp only [r_core_side_a_half_at_one, r_core_side_b_half_at_one]
  rfl

blocks.tex:
The definition is a pair of total real formulas and carries no hypothesis
on $q$.  In Lean, $\sqrt{\cdot}$ is the real square root (zero on negative
arguments) and division by zero is zero, so $R_1$, $R_3$ are defined
everywhere; their geometric meaning below requires $d>0$ together with the
separately stated physical hypotheses of each application.  The identity
links are pure unfolding: the Lean core side at $k=1$ is
$2\sqrt{q^2-v^2}/\sqrt{\Delta(1,u,q,v)}$ (and similarly for $B,C,D$) with
$\Delta(1,u,q,v)=q^2-u^2v^2$, so halving it gives exactly the factor above
(the four \texttt{r\_core\_side\_*\_half\_at\_one} simplifications, which have
no hypotheses), after which both sides agree by definition.  The rectangle
$[p,1]\times[l,1]$ used in the ordered branch below is that branch's
application domain, not a restriction built into the definition.  In the
repeated-maximum branch the same formulas are used with $q=1$ on an
interior rectangle; there $d$ vanishes at the outer corner $(1,1)$ of
$[0,1]^2$, and no positivity of $d$ on the outer square is claimed.

$R_1$ is the actual turn at the mixed slot $(p,t)$ minus the core turn at
the vertex of curvature $u$, and $R_3$ is the actual turn at $(h,l)$ minus the
core turn at the vertex of curvature $v$.  The pure slots $(1,1)$ and $(q,q)$
are the same in the actual model and in the core.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_ordered_walls
blocks.title: core walls on the closed rectangle
blocks.body:
Let $1<q$ and $(u,v)\in[0,1]^2$.  Then $q^2-u^2v^2>0$, so $\mathcal R$ is
  continuous on $[p,1]\times[l,1]$.  If $0<t<q$ then
  $t^2(1-v^2)<q^2-u^2v^2$, and for $v<1$ this is the strict wall
  $t\,B/2<1$.  If $0\le p\le u$, $1<h$ and
  \[
    h^2(1-p^2)+p^2<q^2\qquad\mathrm{(HB)}
  \]
  then $h^2(1-u^2)<q^2-u^2v^2$, and for $u<1$ this is the strict wall
  $h\,C/2<1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_denom_pos_aux
lean.code:
lemma r_denom_pos_aux {q u v : ℝ}
    (hq : 1 < q) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) :
    0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := by
  have huv0 : 0 ≤ u * v := mul_nonneg hu0 hv0
  have huv1 : u * v ≤ 1 := by
    simpa using mul_le_mul hu1 hv1 hv0 zero_le_one
  have huvq : u * v < q := huv1.trans_lt hq
  have hsquare := (sq_lt_sq₀ huv0 (lt_trans zero_lt_one hq).le).2 huvq
  nlinarith [hsquare]

theorem continuousOn_rResidualMap_of_denom_pos
    {p t q h l : ℝ} {s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (hden : ∀ z ∈ s, 0 < q ^ 2 - z.1 ^ 2 * z.2 ^ 2) :
    ContinuousOn (rResidualMap p t q h l) s := by
  have hOne := continuousOn_rResidualOne_of_denom_pos (p := p) (t := t) hden
  have hThree := continuousOn_rResidualThree_of_denom_pos (h := h) (l := l) hden
  exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hOne).add
    ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hThree).mul continuousOn_const)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_actual_h_sideC_wall_lt_one
lean.code:
theorem r_actual_h_sideC_wall_lt_one {p q h u v : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpu : p ≤ u) (hh : 1 < h)
    (hu1 : u < 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1)
    (hbase : h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2) :
    |h * (rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2)| < 1 := by
  let c := √(1 - u ^ 2)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  have hcInside : 0 < 1 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hc, hcsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hcInside
  have hwall := r_h_wall_pos_on_rectangle hp hpu hh hv0 hv1 hbase
  have hh0 : 0 < h := zero_lt_one.trans hh
  have hleft : 0 < h ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) :=
    mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hh0) hcInside
  have hdInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := hleft.trans hwall
  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside
  have hhc : h * c < d := by
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (mul_pos hh0 hc).le hd.le).1
    rw [mul_pow, hcsq, hdsq]
    exact hwall
  have hratio : h * (c / d) < 1 := by
    calc
      h * (c / d) = (h * c) / d := by ring
      _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hd).2 hhc
  rw [r_core_side_c_half_at_one, abs_of_pos]
  · simpa only [c, d] using hratio
  · exact mul_pos hh0 (div_pos hc hd)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_h_wall_pos_on_rectangle
lean.code:

lean.code:
theorem r_actual_t_sideB_wall_lt_one {q t u v : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q)
    (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    |t * (rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2)| < 1 := by
  let b := √(1 - v ^ 2)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2)
  have hbInside : 0 < 1 - v ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hb, hbsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hbInside
  have hwall := r_t_wall_pos_on_rectangle ht htq hq hu0 hu1 hv0 hv1.le
  have hleft : 0 < t ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2) :=
    mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos ht) hbInside
  have hdInside : 0 < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * v ^ 2 := hleft.trans hwall
  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside
  have htb : t * b < d := by
    apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (mul_pos ht hb).le hd.le).1
    rw [mul_pow, hbsq, hdsq]
    exact hwall
  have hratio : t * (b / d) < 1 := by
    calc
      t * (b / d) = (t * b) / d := by ring
      _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hd).2 htb
  rw [r_core_side_b_half_at_one, abs_of_pos]
  · simpa only [b, d] using hratio
  · exact mul_pos ht (div_pos hb hd)

blocks.tex:
$uv\le1<q$ gives the denominator.  The margins are the polynomial
  identities
  \[
    q^2-u^2v^2-t^2(1-v^2)=q^2-t^2+v^2(t^2-u^2),\qquad
    q^2-u^2v^2-h^2(1-u^2)=q^2-h^2+u^2(h^2-v^2).
  \]
  For the first: if $t<u$ it equals $(q^2-u^2)+(1-v^2)(u^2-t^2)>0$; if
  $u\le t$ it is $\ge q^2-t^2>0$.  For the second it equals
  \[
    \bigl(q^2-h^2+p^2(h^2-1)\bigr)+(u^2-p^2)(h^2-v^2)+p^2(1-v^2),
  \]
  whose first bracket is positive by $\mathrm{(HB)}$ and whose other
  terms are nonnegative.  Finally $t\,B/2=t\sqrt{1-v^2}/d$ and
  $h\,C/2=h\sqrt{1-u^2}/d$, so the squared inequalities are the strict walls.

    (hwall : h ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) < q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * l ^ 2) :
    0 < rResidualThree q h l u l := by
  let c := √(1 - u ^ 2)
  let d := √(q ^ 2 - u ^ 2 * l ^ 2)
  have hcInside : 0 < 1 - u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨hc, hcsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hcInside

    mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hl.trans_lt hlh)) hcInside

  obtain ⟨hd, hdsq⟩ := square_root_data_aux hdInside

    exact hwall

theorem r_residual_one_top_neg {p t q u : ℝ}

blocks.tex:
(1) At $u=1$, $C=0$ and $D/2=\sqrt{q^2-1}/\sqrt{q^2-v^2}=:e$, so
  $R_3=\arcsin(le)-\arcsin(ve)<0$ since $l<v$ and $ve\le1$ ($v\le1$).
  (2) At $v=1$, $B=0$ and $A/2=\sqrt{q^2-1}/\sqrt{q^2-u^2}=:a$, so
  $R_1=\arcsin(pa)-\arcsin(ua)<0$ since $p<u$ and $ua\le1$.
  (3) At $u=p$ the $A$-terms cancel and $R_1=\arcsin(tB/2)-\arcsin(pB/2)>0$,
  because $p<t$ and $tB/2<1$ (\cref{lem:nfp_ordered_walls}).
  (4) At $v=l$ the $D$-terms cancel and $R_3=\arcsin(hC/2)-\arcsin(lC/2)>0$,
  because $l<1<h$ and $hC/2<1$ (\cref{lem:nfp_ordered_walls}, using
  $\mathrm{(HB)}$ and $p\le u$).
  (5) At $(1,l)$: $A/2=1$ and $B/2=\sqrt{1-l^2}/\sqrt{q^2-l^2}=\sigma(q,l)$,
  so $R_1=\arcsin p+\arcsin(t\sigma(q,l))-\pi/2-\arcsin\sigma(q,l)
  =\Phi(p,t,q,l)$, the predecessor flag.
  (6) At $(p,1)$: $D/2=1$ and $C/2=\rho$, which gives the formula.

For the remaining signs put
\[
  r=\sqrt{1-p^2},\qquad a=\sqrt{\frac{h^2-1}{1-l^2}},\qquad
  s=\sigma(h,l),\qquad \rho=\frac{\sqrt{1-p^2}}{\sqrt{q^2-p^2}},
\]
so that $r^2=1-p^2$, $a^2(1-l^2)=h^2-1$, $s^2(1+a^2)=1$ (because
$1+a^2=(h^2-l^2)/(1-l^2)$) and $\rho^2(q^2-p^2)=r^2$.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_critical_hwall
blocks.title: the current flag in rectangle form
blocks.body:
If $0<p<1$, $0<l<1$, $1<q<h$ and $\Phi(p,q,h,l)\ge0$, then
  \[
    p+ra\le q,\qquad h^2r^2+p^2<(p+ra)^2,\qquad
    h^2(1-p^2)+p^2<q^2 .
  \]
  The last inequality $\mathrm{(HB)}$ is strict even when the flag is
  zero.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.one_lt_criticalValue
lean.code:
lemma one_lt_criticalValue {p r a s : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsp : s < p) (hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2)
    (hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1) :
    1 < p + r * a := by
  have hs_sq_lt : s ^ 2 < p ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hs.le hp.le).2 hsp
  have ha1 : 0 < 1 + a ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hp_scale : 1 < p ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) := by
    calc
      1 = s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) := hseq.symm
      _ < p ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs_sq_lt ha1
  have hpa_sq : r ^ 2 < (p * a) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hrsq]
    nlinarith
  have hpa : r < p * a :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hr.le (mul_pos hp ha).le).1 hpa_sq
  have hp1 : p < 1 := by
    have hr_sq : 0 < r ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr
    nlinarith
  have hra : 0 < r * a := mul_pos hr ha
  have hmul : r ^ 2 < r * p * a := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hpa hr
    nlinarith
  have hstep : (1 - p) * (1 + p) < (r * a) * (1 + p) := by
    calc
      (1 - p) * (1 + p) = r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      _ < r * p * a := hmul
      _ < (r * a) * (1 + p) := by
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show p < 1 + p by linarith) hra
        nlinarith
  have hgap : 1 - p < r * a :=
    lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right hstep (show 0 ≤ 1 + p by linarith)
  linarith

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.critical_hWall_pos
lean.code:
theorem critical_hWall_pos {p h l r a s : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsp : s < p) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2)
    (haeq : a ^ 2 * (1 - l ^ 2) = h ^ 2 - 1)
    (hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1) :
    h ^ 2 * r ^ 2 + p ^ 2 < (p + r * a) ^ 2 := by
  have hl_sq : l ^ 2 < 1 := by
    simpa using (sq_lt_sq₀ hl.le zero_le_one).2 hl1
  have hx : 0 < 1 - l ^ 2 := sub_pos.mpr hl_sq
  have hh_sq : 0 < h ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hbase_product :
      (a ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + 2) * (1 - l ^ 2) =
        (1 - l ^ 2) + l ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - 1) := by
    nlinarith
  have hbase_rhs : 0 < (1 - l ^ 2) + l ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - 1) := by
    positivity
  have hbase_product_pos :
      0 < (a ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + 2) * (1 - l ^ 2) := by
    rw [hbase_product]
    exact hbase_rhs
  have hbase : 0 < a ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + 2 := by
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_left hbase_product_pos hx.le
  have hs_sq_lt : s ^ 2 < p ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hs.le hp.le).2 hsp
  have ha1 : 0 < 1 + a ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hp_scale : 1 < p ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) := by
    calc
      1 = s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) := hseq.symm
      _ < p ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hs_sq_lt ha1
  have hpa_sq : r ^ 2 < (p * a) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hrsq]
    nlinarith
  have hpa : r < p * a :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hr.le (mul_pos hp ha).le).1 hpa_sq
  have hcross : 2 * r ^ 2 < 2 * p * r * a := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hpa (show 0 < 2 * r by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hscaled_base : 0 < r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - h ^ 2 + 2) := by
    positivity
  rw [← sub_pos, critical_hWall_identity]
  nlinarith

lemma critical_hWall_identity (p h r a : ℝ) :
    (p + r * a) ^ 2 - (h ^ 2 * r ^ 2 + p ^ 2) =
      r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 - h ^ 2) + 2 * p * r * a := by

theorem r_corner_residual_neg_of_one_lt_mul {h l rho rho0 d : ℝ}
    (hh : 1 < h) (hl0 : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1) (hhl : 1 < h * l)
    (hrho0 : 0 ≤ rho) (hrho : rho < rho0)
    (hd : d = h ^ 2 + 1 - 2 * h * l) (hrho0pos : 0 < rho0)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_corner_residual_neg_of_failure
lean.code:
theorem r_corner_residual_neg_of_failure {p q h l r a s rho : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s) (hsp : s < p)
    (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2)
    (haeq : a ^ 2 * (1 - l ^ 2) = h ^ 2 - 1)
    (hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1)
    (hqcrit : p + r * a ≤ q) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hrhoSq : rho ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - p ^ 2) = r ^ 2) :
    Real.arcsin (h * rho) + Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin rho - Real.pi / 2 < 0 := by
  have hwall := critical_hWall_pos hp hr ha hs hsp hh hl hl1 hrsq haeq hseq
  by_cases hhl : h * l ≤ 1
  · have hrhoInv := r_corner_rho_lt_inv_aux hp hr ha hh hqcrit hwall hrho hrhoSq
    exact r_corner_residual_neg_of_mul_le_one hh hrho.le hrhoInv hhl
  · have hhl' : 1 < h * l := lt_of_not_ge hhl
    obtain ⟨d, rho0, hd, hrho0, hrho0Sq, hrhoLt⟩ :=
      exists_r_corner_threshold_gt_rho_aux hp hr ha hl hl1 hhl' haeq hqcrit

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_corner_residual_neg_of_mul_le_one
lean.code:
theorem r_corner_residual_neg_of_mul_le_one {h l rho : ℝ}
    (hh : 1 < h) (hrho0 : 0 ≤ rho) (hrho : rho < 1 / h) (hhl : h * l ≤ 1) :
    Real.arcsin (h * rho) + Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin rho - Real.pi / 2 < 0 := by
  have hh0 : 0 < h := lt_trans zero_lt_one hh
  have hl : l ≤ 1 / h := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]
    simpa [mul_comm] using hhl
  have hinv0 : 0 ≤ 1 / h := one_div_nonneg.mpr hh0.le
  have hdiff := strictMonoOn_arcsin_mul_sub_arcsin hh
    ⟨hrho0, hrho.le⟩ ⟨hinv0, le_rfl⟩ hrho
  dsimp only at hdiff
  rw [show h * (1 / h) = 1 by field_simp, Real.arcsin_one] at hdiff
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : _ < Real.arcsin l - Real.arcsin (1 / h))
    (sub_nonpos.mpr (Real.arcsin_le_arcsin hl))

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.strictMonoOn_arcsin_mul_sub_arcsin
lean.code:
theorem strictMonoOn_arcsin_mul_sub_arcsin {h : ℝ} (hh : 1 < h) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun x ↦ Real.arcsin (h * x) - Real.arcsin x) (Icc 0 (1 / h)) := by
  apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Icc _ _)
  · fun_prop
  · intro x hx
    rw [interior_Icc] at hx
    have hh0 : 0 < h := lt_trans zero_lt_one hh
    have hhx1 : h * x < 1 := by
      have := (lt_div_iff₀ hh0).1 hx.2
      nlinarith
    have hx1 : x < 1 := hx.2.trans ((div_lt_one hh0).2 hh)
    have hhx0 : 0 < h * x := mul_pos hh0 hx.1
    have hd₁ := (Real.hasDerivAt_arcsin (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)).comp x
      (hasDerivAt_const_mul h)
    have hd₂ := Real.hasDerivAt_arcsin (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith : x ≠ 1)
    have hd := hd₁.sub hd₂
    change 0 < deriv ((Real.arcsin ∘ fun y ↦ h * y) - Real.arcsin) x
    rw [hd.deriv]
    have hA : 0 < √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 <|
      sub_pos.mpr ((sq_lt_one_iff₀ hhx0.le).2 hhx1)
    have hB : 0 < √(1 - x ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 <|
      sub_pos.mpr ((sq_lt_one_iff₀ hx.1.le).2 hx1)
    have hxlt : x < h * x := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hh) hx.1]
    have hsq : x ^ 2 < (h * x) ^ 2 := (sq_lt_sq₀ hx.1.le hhx0.le).2 hxlt
    have hAB : √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) < √(1 - x ^ 2) :=
      Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
    have hinv : 1 / √(1 - x ^ 2) < 1 / √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) :=
      one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt hA hAB
    have hscale :
        1 / √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) < 1 / √(1 - (h * x) ^ 2) * h := by
      simpa using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hh (one_div_pos.mpr hA)
    exact sub_pos.mpr (hinv.trans hscale)

blocks.tex:
Let $f(x)=\arcsin(hx)-\arcsin x$ on $[0,1/h]$.  Its derivative
  $h/\sqrt{1-h^2x^2}-1/\sqrt{1-x^2}$ is positive in the interior (the first
  denominator is smaller and $h>1$), so $f$ is strictly increasing, and
  $f(1/h)=\pi/2-\arcsin(1/h)$.  The claim is $f(\rho)<\pi/2-\arcsin l$.

  \emph{Case $hl\le1$.}  From \cref{lem:nfp_critical_hwall},
  $(h\rho)^2(q^2-p^2)=h^2r^2<(p+ra)^2-p^2\le q^2-p^2$, so $h\rho<1$, i.e.\
  $\rho<1/h$.  Then $f(\rho)<f(1/h)=\pi/2-\arcsin(1/h)\le\pi/2-\arcsin l$
  because $l\le1/h$.

  \emph{Case $1<hl$.}  Put $d=h^2+1-2hl=(h-l)^2+(1-l^2)>0$ and
  $\rho_0=\sqrt{(1-l^2)/d}$.  Direct computation gives
  $d(1-h^2\rho_0^2)=(hl-1)^2$ and $d(1-\rho_0^2)=(h-l)^2$; in particular
  $h\rho_0<1$, i.e.\ $\rho_0<1/h$.  Taking the positive roots ($hl>1$,
  $h>l$),
  \[
    \cos\bigl(f(\rho_0)\bigr)=\sqrt{1-h^2\rho_0^2}\sqrt{1-\rho_0^2}+h\rho_0^2
    =\frac{(hl-1)(h-l)+h(1-l^2)}d=\frac{l\,d}d=l,
  \]
  and $f(\rho_0)\in[0,\pi]$, so $f(\rho_0)=\arccos l=\pi/2-\arcsin l$: the
  corner residual vanishes at the threshold $\rho_0$.  It remains to show
  $\rho<\rho_0$.  Using $a^2(1-l^2)=h^2-1$,
  \[
    (1-l^2)\bigl((p+ra)^2-p^2\bigr)-r^2d=2(1-l^2)pra+2r^2(hl-1)>0,
  \]
  so $r^2d<(1-l^2)((p+ra)^2-p^2)\le(1-l^2)(q^2-p^2)$.  With
  $\rho^2(q^2-p^2)=r^2$ and $\rho_0^2d=1-l^2$ this is
  $\rho^2<\rho_0^2$.  Hence $\rho<\rho_0<1/h$, and strict monotonicity gives
  $f(\rho)<f(\rho_0)=\pi/2-\arcsin l$.

  Both branches derive the sign from the flag; it is not an assumed
  inequality.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.exists_r_rectangle_boundary_winding_eq_one
lean.code:
theorem exists_r_rectangle_boundary_winding_eq_one
    {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hpt : p < t) (htq : t < q)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hbase : h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2)
    (htopLeft : rResidualThree q h l p 1 < 0)
    (hbottomRight : rResidualOne p t q 1 l < 0) :
    ∃ (gamma : C(unitInterval, ℂ)) (hgamma : ∀ s, gamma s ≠ 0),
      (∀ s, gamma s =
        rResidualMap p t q h l (fourArcRectangleBoundary p 1 l 1 s)) ∧
      Gluck.windingNumberC gamma hgamma = 1 := by
  have hden : ∀ z ∈ Icc p 1 ×ˢ Icc l 1,
      0 < q ^ 2 - z.1 ^ 2 * z.2 ^ 2 := by
    intro z hz
    exact r_denom_pos_aux hq (hp.le.trans hz.1.1) hz.1.2
      (hl.le.trans hz.2.1) hz.2.2
  have hcont := continuousOn_rResidualMap_of_denom_pos
    (p := p) (t := t) (h := h) (l := l) hden
  let gamma := fourArcRectangleBoundaryMap (rResidualMap p t q h l)
    hp1.le hl1.le hcont
  have hright : ∀ s : unitInterval,
      ((s : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (s : ℝ)) → (gamma s).im < 0 :=
    fun _ hs ↦ r_boundary_right_neg_aux hp1.le hl.le hl1 hq hs
  have htop : ∀ s : unitInterval,
      1 / 8 ≤ (s : ℝ) → (s : ℝ) < 3 / 8 → (gamma s).re < 0 :=
    fun _ hs0 hs1 ↦ r_boundary_top_neg_aux hp.le hp1 hl1.le hq hs0 hs1
  have hleft : ∀ s : unitInterval,
      3 / 8 < (s : ℝ) → (s : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 8 → 0 < (gamma s).re :=
    fun _ hs0 hs1 ↦
      r_boundary_left_pos_aux hp hp1 hpt htq hq hl.le hl1 hs0 hs1
  have hbottom : ∀ s : unitInterval,
      5 / 8 ≤ (s : ℝ) → (s : ℝ) < 7 / 8 → 0 < (gamma s).im :=
    fun _ hs0 hs1 ↦ r_boundary_bottom_pos_aux hp hp1 hh hl.le hl1 hbase hs0 hs1
  have htopLeft' : ∀ s : unitInterval,
      (s : ℝ) = 3 / 8 → (gamma s).im < 0 :=
    fun _ hs ↦ r_boundary_top_left_neg_aux htopLeft hs
  have hbottomRight' : ∀ s : unitInterval,
      (s : ℝ) = 7 / 8 → (gamma s).re < 0 :=
    fun _ hs ↦ r_boundary_bottom_right_neg_aux hbottomRight hs
  have hgamma := ne_zero_of_crossed_fourArcs gamma hright htop hleft hbottom
    htopLeft' hbottomRight'
  have hloop : gamma 0 = gamma 1 :=
    fourArcRectangleBoundaryMap_zero_eq_one _ hp1.le hl1.le hcont
  have hwind := windingNumberC_eq_one_of_crossed_fourArcs gamma hgamma hloop
    hright htop hleft hbottom htopLeft' hbottomRight'
  exact ⟨gamma, hgamma, fun _ ↦ rfl, hwind⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.exists_ordered_r_zero
lean.code:
theorem exists_ordered_r_zero
    {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hpt : p < t) (htq : t < q) (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hflag : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p q h l)
    (hprev : firstPairFlag p t q l < 0) :
    h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2 ∧
      ∃ z ∈ Ioo p 1 ×ˢ Ioo l 1, rResidualMap p t q h l z = 0 := by
  let r := √(1 - p ^ 2)
  let a := √((h ^ 2 - 1) / (1 - l ^ 2))
  let s := firstPairSigma h l
  let rho := √(1 - p ^ 2) / √(q ^ 2 - p ^ 2)
  have hP : 0 < 1 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hL : 0 < 1 - l ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hH : 0 < h ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hQ : 0 < q ^ 2 - p ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hP
  have ha : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (div_pos hH hL)
  have hr2 : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hP.le
  have ha2 : a ^ 2 = (h ^ 2 - 1) / (1 - l ^ 2) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (div_pos hH hL).le
  have haeq : a ^ 2 * (1 - l ^ 2) = h ^ 2 - 1 := by
    rw [ha2, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hL)]
  obtain ⟨hs, _hs1, hsig, _hswall⟩ := firstPairSigma_data (by linarith : 1 < h) hl hl1
  have hsp : s < p := (firstPairFlag_guard_and_bound hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag).1
  have hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1 := by
    have he : (1 + a ^ 2) * (1 - l ^ 2) = h ^ 2 - l ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hs' : s ^ 2 * (h ^ 2 - l ^ 2) = 1 - l ^ 2 := hsig
    apply (mul_left_inj' (ne_of_gt hL)).mp
    nlinarith [congrArg (fun z : ℝ => s ^ 2 * z) he]
  have hsq := firstPairFlag_square_bound hp hp1 hl hl1 hq hqh hflag
  have hcrit : p + r * a ≤ q := by
    have hprod : (r * a) ^ 2 * (1 - l ^ 2) =
        (1 - p ^ 2) * (h ^ 2 - 1) := by
      rw [mul_pow, hr2]
      nlinarith [congrArg (fun z : ℝ => (1 - p ^ 2) * z) haeq]
    have hsq' : (r * a) ^ 2 ≤ (q - p) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have hle := (sq_le_sq₀ (mul_pos hr ha).le (by linarith : 0 ≤ q - p)).mp hsq'
    linarith
  have hrho : 0 < rho := div_pos hr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ)
  have hrhosq : rho ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - p ^ 2) = r ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [rho, r]
    rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hQ)]
  have hbase : h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2 := by
    have hw := critical_hWall_pos hp hr ha hs hsp (by linarith) hl hl1 hr2 haeq hseq
    have hc := (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ p + r * a)
      (by linarith : 0 ≤ q)).mpr hcrit
    rw [hr2] at hw
    exact hw.trans_le hc
  refine ⟨hbase, exists_r_residual_zero_of_failure hp hr ha hs hsp hpt htq
    (by linarith) hl hl1 hr2 haeq hseq hcrit hrho hrhosq rfl ?_⟩
  rwa [r_corner_eq_firstPairFlag hl hl1 hq]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.exists_r_residual_zero_of_failure
lean.code:
theorem exists_r_residual_zero_of_failure
    {p t q h l r a s rho : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s) (hsp : s < p)
    (hpt : p < t) (htq : t < q) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2)
    (haeq : a ^ 2 * (1 - l ^ 2) = h ^ 2 - 1)
    (hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1)
    (hqcrit : p + r * a ≤ q) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hrhoSq : rho ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - p ^ 2) = r ^ 2)
    (hrhoEq : rho = √(1 - p ^ 2) / √(q ^ 2 - p ^ 2))
    (hbottomRight : rResidualOne p t q 1 l < 0) :
    ∃ z ∈ Ioo p 1 ×ˢ Ioo l 1, rResidualMap p t q h l z = 0 := by
  have hp1 : p < 1 := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hr]
  have hq : 1 < q :=
    (one_lt_criticalValue hp hr ha hs hsp hrsq hseq).trans_le hqcrit
  exact exists_r_residual_zero_of_winding_aux hp.le hp1 hq hl.le hl1 <|
    exists_r_rectangle_boundary_winding_eq_one_of_failure hp hr ha hs hsp hpt
      htq hh hl hl1 hrsq haeq hseq hqcrit hrho hrhoSq hrhoEq hbottomRight

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.r_residual_zero_mem_interior
lean.code:
theorem r_residual_zero_mem_interior
    {p t q h l : ℝ} {z : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hpt : p < t) (htq : t < q)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hbase : h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2)
    (htopLeft : rResidualThree q h l p 1 < 0)
    (hbottomRight : rResidualOne p t q 1 l < 0)
    (hz : z ∈ Icc p 1 ×ˢ Icc l 1)
    (hzero : rResidualMap p t q h l z = 0) :
    z ∈ Ioo p 1 ×ˢ Ioo l 1 := by
  have hOne : rResidualOne p t q z.1 z.2 = 0 := by
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re hzero
    simpa using hre
  have hThree : rResidualThree q h l z.1 z.2 = 0 := by
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hzero
    simpa using him
  have hpu : p < z.1 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have huEq : z.1 = p := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hnot) hz.1.1
    by_cases hvEq : z.2 = 1
    · have hneg : rResidualThree q h l z.1 z.2 < 0 := by
        simpa [huEq, hvEq] using htopLeft
      linarith
    · have hv1 : z.2 < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hz.2.2 hvEq
      have hwall := r_t_wall_pos_aux (hp.trans hpt) htq hq hp.le hp1.le
        (hl.le.trans hz.2.1) hz.2.2
      have hpos : 0 < rResidualOne p t q z.1 z.2 := by
        simpa [huEq] using
          r_residual_one_left_pos hp hpt (hl.le.trans hz.2.1) hv1 hwall
      linarith
  have hu1 : z.1 < 1 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have huEq : z.1 = 1 := le_antisymm hz.1.2 (not_lt.mp hnot)
    by_cases hvEq : z.2 = l
    · have hneg : rResidualOne p t q z.1 z.2 < 0 := by
        simpa [huEq, hvEq] using hbottomRight
      linarith
    · have hlv : l < z.2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hz.2.1 (Ne.symm hvEq)
      have hneg : rResidualThree q h l z.1 z.2 < 0 := by
        simpa [huEq] using
          r_residual_three_right_neg hl.le hlv hz.2.2 hq
      linarith
  have hlv : l < z.2 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hvEq : z.2 = l := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hnot) hz.2.1
    have hwall := r_h_wall_pos_aux hp.le hz.1.1 hh hl.le hl1.le hbase
    have hpos : 0 < rResidualThree q h l z.1 z.2 := by
      simpa [hvEq] using r_residual_three_bottom_pos hl.le
        (hl1.trans hh) (hp.le.trans hz.1.1) hu1 hwall
    linarith
  have hv1 : z.2 < 1 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hvEq : z.2 = 1 := le_antisymm hz.2.2 (not_lt.mp hnot)
    have hneg : rResidualOne p t q z.1 z.2 < 0 := by
      simpa [hvEq] using r_residual_one_top_neg hp.le hpu hz.1.2 hq
    linarith
  exact ⟨⟨hpu, hu1⟩, ⟨hlv, hv1⟩⟩

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.exists_r_rectangle_boundary_winding_eq_one_of_failure
lean.code:
theorem exists_r_rectangle_boundary_winding_eq_one_of_failure
    {p t q h l r a s rho : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s) (hsp : s < p)
    (hpt : p < t) (htq : t < q) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)
    (hrsq : r ^ 2 = 1 - p ^ 2)
    (haeq : a ^ 2 * (1 - l ^ 2) = h ^ 2 - 1)
    (hseq : s ^ 2 * (1 + a ^ 2) = 1)
    (hqcrit : p + r * a ≤ q) (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hrhoSq : rho ^ 2 * (q ^ 2 - p ^ 2) = r ^ 2)
    (hrhoEq : rho = √(1 - p ^ 2) / √(q ^ 2 - p ^ 2))
    (hbottomRight : rResidualOne p t q 1 l < 0) :
    ∃ (gamma : C(unitInterval, ℂ)) (hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ≠ 0),
      (∀ u, gamma u =
        rResidualMap p t q h l (fourArcRectangleBoundary p 1 l 1 u)) ∧
      Gluck.windingNumberC gamma hgamma = 1 := by
  have hp1 : p < 1 := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hr]
  have hcritical := one_lt_criticalValue hp hr ha hs hsp hrsq hseq
  have hq : 1 < q := hcritical.trans_le hqcrit
  have hcriticalSq : (p + r * a) ^ 2 ≤ q ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (lt_trans zero_lt_one hcritical).le
      (lt_trans zero_lt_one hq).le).2 hqcrit
  have hbase : h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hrsq]
    exact (critical_hWall_pos hp hr ha hs hsp hh hl hl1 hrsq haeq hseq).trans_le
      hcriticalSq
  have htopLeft : rResidualThree q h l p 1 < 0 := by
    rw [r_residual_three_top_left_eq hp.le (hp1.trans hq), ← hrhoEq]
    exact r_corner_residual_neg_of_failure hp hr ha hs hsp hh hl hl1 hrsq
      haeq hseq hqcrit hrho hrhoSq
  exact exists_r_rectangle_boundary_winding_eq_one hp hp1 hpt htq hq hh hl hl1
    hbase htopLeft hbottomRight

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.N6TypeAThreeCell.exists_r_residual_zero
lean.code:
theorem exists_r_residual_zero
    {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hpt : p < t) (htq : t < q)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hh : 1 < h) (hl : 0 < l) (hl1 : l < 1)

    (hbottomRight : rResidualOne p t q 1 l < 0) :

  exists_r_residual_zero_of_winding_aux hp.le hp1 hq hl.le hl1 <|
    exists_r_rectangle_boundary_winding_eq_one hp hp1 hpt htq hq hh hl hl1
      hbase htopLeft hbottomRight

  predecessor hypothesis give $R_1(1,l)=\Phi(p,t,q,l)<0$.

  Let $\gamma$ be $\mathcal R$ along the canonical boundary loop of
  $[p,1]\times[l,1]$ (\cref{def:fad_boundary_map}); it is continuous because
  the denominator is positive on the closed rectangle
  (\cref{lem:nfp_ordered_walls}).  Compare with
  \cref{def:fad_crossed_pattern}: on the right arc $u=1$, $v>l$ and
  $\Im\gamma=R_3<0$; on the top arc $v=1$, $u>p$ and $\Re\gamma=R_1<0$; on
  the left arc $u=p$, $v<1$ and $\Re\gamma=R_1>0$; on the bottom arc
  $v=l$, $u<1$ and $\Im\gamma=R_3>0$ (\cref{lem:nfp_ordered_faces}(1)--(4),
  with the strict interiority of open arcs of \cref{sec:fad_rect}).  The two
  exceptional parameters $\tfrac38$ and $\tfrac78$ are the corners $(p,1)$
  and $(1,l)$, where the required signs are $\Im\gamma=R_3(p,1)<0$ and
  $\Re\gamma=R_1(1,l)<0$ --- exactly the two corner signs just proved.
  Hence $\gamma$ has the crossed four-arc signs, is nowhere zero
  (\cref{thm:fad_ne_zero}) and has winding number one
  (\cref{thm:fad_winding_one}).  By \cref{thm:fad_exists_zero}, $\mathcal R$
  has a zero in the open rectangle.  (Every zero in the closed rectangle is
  in fact interior, by the same face signs.)

  The predecessor flag enters only through the bottom-right corner; the
  current flag enters through $\mathrm{(HB)}$, the corner sign at the
  top-left, and $1<q$.  Nothing here is a scalar root assumption.

lean.code:
theorem orderedCoreHalfLengths_physical {p t q h l u v : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hl : 0 < l) (hpt : p < t) (htq : t < q)
    (hq : 1 < q) (hqh : q < h)
    (hpu : p < u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hlv : l < v) (hv1 : v < 1)
    (hbase : h ^ 2 * (1 - p ^ 2) + p ^ 2 < q ^ 2) :
    NativeLengthPhysical p t q h l (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v) := by
  have hu : 0 < u := hp.trans hpu
  have hv : 0 < v := hl.trans hlv
  have hd := r_core_realization_data (q := q) zero_lt_one hu (by linarith) hv
    hu1 (by linarith) hv1 (by linarith)
  have hs := r_core_sides_pos zero_lt_one hu (by linarith : 0 < q) hv
    hu1 (by linarith) hv1 (by linarith)
  have hm := moderateArc_zero_iff.mp hd.1
  have hw0 := (hm (0 : ZMod 4)).2
  have hw1 := (hm (1 : ZMod 4)).2
  have hw2 := (hm (2 : ZMod 4)).2
  have hw3 := (hm (3 : ZMod 4)).2
  change |(1 : ℝ)| * (rCoreSideD 1 u q v / 2) < 1 ∧
    |(1 : ℝ)| * (rCoreSideA 1 u q v / 2) < 1 at hw0
  change |u| * (rCoreSideA 1 u q v / 2) < 1 ∧
    |u| * (rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2) < 1 at hw1
  change |q| * (rCoreSideB 1 u q v / 2) < 1 ∧
    |q| * (rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2) < 1 at hw2
  change |v| * (rCoreSideC 1 u q v / 2) < 1 ∧
    |v| * (rCoreSideD 1 u q v / 2) < 1 at hw3
  simp only [abs_one, one_mul] at hw0
  rw [abs_of_pos hu] at hw1
  rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < q)] at hw2
  rw [abs_of_pos hv] at hw3
  have htB := r_actual_t_sideB_wall_lt_one (hp.trans hpt) htq hq
    hu.le hu1.le hv.le hv1
  have hhC := r_actual_h_sideC_wall_lt_one hp.le hpu.le (by linarith)
    hu1 hv.le hv1.le hbase
  refine ⟨?_, hw0.2, ?_, (abs_lt.mp htB).2, hw2.1, hw2.2,
    (abs_lt.mp hhC).2, ?_, hw0.1⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact half_pos hs.1
    · exact half_pos hs.2.1
    · exact half_pos hs.2.2.1
    · exact half_pos hs.2.2.2
  · exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hpu (half_pos hs.1)).trans hw1.1
  · exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlv (half_pos hs.2.2.2)).trans hw3.2

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.NativeOppositePure.native_zero_of_ordered_r_zero
lean.code:
theorem native_zero_of_ordered_r_zero {p t q h l u v : ℝ}
    (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) (hq : 1 < q) (hu1 : u < 1) (hv1 : v < 1)
    (hz : rResidualMap p t q h l (u, v) = 0) :
    nativeLengthController p t q h l (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v) = 0 := by
  have hd := r_core_realization_data (q := q) zero_lt_one hu (by linarith) hv
    hu1 (by linarith) hv1 (by linarith)
  have hcore := native_zero_of_four_realization hd.2.1 hd.2.2.1
  have hr1 : rResidualOne p t q u v = 0 := by
    simpa [rResidualMap] using congrArg Complex.re hz
  have hr3 : rResidualThree q h l u v = 0 := by
    simpa [rResidualMap] using congrArg Complex.im hz
  rw [r_residual_one_eq_core_sides] at hr1
  rw [r_residual_three_eq_core_sides] at hr3
  have hturn : lengthTurns p t q h l (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v) =
      lengthTurns u u q v v (orderedCoreHalfLengths u q v) := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [lengthTurns, orderedCoreHalfLengths] <;> linarith
  unfold nativeLengthController
  rw [hturn]
  exact hcore

deps.title: core walls on the closed rectangle
deps.label: lem:nfp_ordered_walls

blocks.tex:
\emph{Zero.}  Write $L=L^{\mathrm{core}}=(A/2,B/2,C/2,D/2)$.  The native
  turns with readings $(p,t,q,h,l)$ and the native turns with the core
  readings $(u,u,q,v,v)$ agree slot by slot: $\theta_0$ and $\theta_2$ do not
  involve the mixed readings, $\theta_1$ differs by $R_1=0$ and $\theta_3$
  by $R_3=0$.  Hence $N_{(p,t,q,h,l)}(L)=N_{(u,u,q,v,v)}(L)$.  The latter is
  the four-edge closure and turn of the core development of
  \cref{lem:nfp_ordered_core}: its turning angles are
  $\theta_0,\dots,\theta_3$, its closure gap equals
  $2u(\theta_0)\cdot N_1$ (lengths $2L_j$, heading gauge of the first edge),
  and $\theta_0+\dots+\theta_3=2\pi$.  So both components of $N$ vanish:
  literal native closure and the lifted full turn.

  \emph{Eight walls.}  From the strict moderate walls of the core
  (curvatures $1,u,q,v$): $L_0<1$, $uL_0<1$, $uL_1<1$, $qL_1<1$, $qL_2<1$,
  $vL_2<1$, $vL_3<1$, $L_3<1$.  The original walls follow: $pL_0<uL_0<1$
  (as $p<u$); $lL_3<vL_3<1$ (as $l<v$); $qL_1,qL_2,L_0,L_3<1$ are shared;
  $tL_1<1$ and $hL_2<1$ are \cref{lem:nfp_ordered_walls} (the latter needs
  $\mathrm{(HB)}$).  Positivity is \cref{lem:nfp_ordered_core}.  Note
  that $t$ may exceed $1$ and $h$ exceeds $q$: these two walls are genuinely
  different from the core walls and are proved separately.

blocks.title: the least transition on a rising interval
blocks.body:
Let $w\colon\mathbb N\to\RR$, $0<a\le k$, $p<1$, and assume
  \[
    w(a-1)\le1<w(a),\qquad w\ \text{strictly increasing on}\ [a,k],\qquad
    \Phi\bigl(p,w(k-1),w(k),l\bigr)\ge0 .
  \]
  Then there is $i$ with $a\le i<k$, $1<w(i)$,
  $w(i-1)<w(i)<w(i+1)$,
  \[
    \Phi\bigl(p,w(i),w(i+1),l\bigr)\ge0
    \quad\text{and}\quad
    \Phi\bigl(p,w(i-1),w(i),l\bigr)<0 .
  \]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_firstPair_transition_on_rising_interval
lean.code:
theorem exists_firstPair_transition_on_rising_interval
    {w : ℕ → ℝ} {p l : ℝ} {a k : ℕ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hak : a ≤ k) (hp : p < 1)
    (hentry : w (a - 1) ≤ 1) (hhigh : 1 < w a)
    (hrise : StrictMonoOn w (Icc a k))
    (hterminal : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p (w (k - 1)) (w k) l) :
    ∃ i, a ≤ i ∧ i < k ∧ 1 < w i ∧ w (i - 1) < w i ∧ w i < w (i + 1) ∧
      0 ≤ firstPairFlag p (w i) (w (i + 1)) l ∧
      firstPairFlag p (w (i - 1)) (w i) l < 0 := by
  classical
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun i => a - 1 ≤ i ∧ i < k ∧
    0 ≤ firstPairFlag p (w i) (w (i + 1)) l
  have hex : ∃ i, P i := by
    refine ⟨k - 1, ?_⟩
    change a - 1 ≤ k - 1 ∧ k - 1 < k ∧ _
    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ k)] using hterminal
  let i := Nat.find hex
  have hi := Nat.find_spec hex
  change a - 1 ≤ i ∧ i < k ∧ 0 ≤ firstPairFlag p (w i) (w (i + 1)) l at hi
  have hai : a ≤ i := by
    by_contra h
    have hieq : i = a - 1 := by omega
    have hneg := firstPairFlag_lt_zero_of_le_one (h := w a) (l := l) hp hentry
    have hnonneg := hi.2.2
    rw [hieq, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ a)] at hnonneg
    linarith
  have hprev : firstPairFlag p (w (i - 1)) (w i) l < 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have hPi : P (i - 1) := by
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ i)] using le_of_not_gt h
    have hmin := Nat.find_min' hex hPi
    change i ≤ i - 1 at hmin
    omega
  have hqi : 1 < w i := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hai with heq | hlt
    · simpa [← heq] using hhigh
    · exact hhigh.trans (hrise ⟨le_rfl, hak⟩ ⟨hai, hi.2.1.le⟩ hlt)
  have hti : w (i - 1) < w i := by
    by_cases hia : i = a
    · simpa only [hia] using lt_of_le_of_lt hentry hhigh
    · apply hrise ⟨by omega, by omega⟩ ⟨hai, hi.2.1.le⟩
      omega
  have hiNext : w i < w (i + 1) :=
    hrise ⟨hai, hi.2.1.le⟩ ⟨by omega, by omega⟩ (by omega)
  exact ⟨i, hai, hi.2.1, hqi, hti, hiNext, hi.2.2, hprev⟩

deps.title: a low entry forces a negative flag
deps.label: lem:nfp_flag_negative

blocks.tex:
Let $i$ be the least natural number with $a-1\le i<k$ and
  $\Phi(p,w(i),w(i+1),l)\ge0$; it exists because $i=k-1$ qualifies by the
  terminal hypothesis.  The index $a-1$ does not qualify:
  $\Phi(p,w(a-1),w(a),l)<0$ by \cref{lem:nfp_flag_negative}, since
  $w(a-1)\le1$ and $p<1$.  Hence $a\le i$.  Then $i-1\ge a-1$ and $i-1<k$,
  so minimality gives $\Phi(p,w(i-1),w(i),l)<0$.  If $i=a$ then
  $w(i)=w(a)>1$ and $w(i-1)=w(a-1)\le1<w(a)$ (this is the separate
  comparison with the entry value); if $i>a$ then $w(i)>w(a)>1$ and
  $w(i-1)<w(i)$ by the strict rise on $[a,k]$.  Finally $i+1\le k$, so
  $w(i)<w(i+1)$.  The argument is a finite minimum over the actual indices;
  no count of readings and no bound on $n$ enters.

blocks.label: lem:nfp_frame
blocks.title: the frame at a transition
blocks.body:
If $2\le i$ and $i+2\le n$, then $0<i-1<i<n-1$ is a frame of size $n$.  For
  every $\kappa\colon\ZMod n\to\RR$ with $\kappa_0=1$ its start and finish
  vectors are
  \[
    (1,\kappa_{i-1},\kappa_i,\kappa_{n-1}),\qquad
    (\kappa_1,\kappa_i,\kappa_{i+1},1).
  \]

theorem firstPairFrame_start {n i : ℕ} (hi : 2 ≤ i) (hin : i + 2 ≤ n)
    (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (hzero : κ 0 = 1) :
    (firstPairFrame hi hin).start κ =
      ![1, κ ((i - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n), κ (i : ZMod n), κ ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n)] := by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [Frame.start, Frame.residue, firstPairFrame, hzero]

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.FourActiveSlots.firstPairFrame_finish

theorem firstPairFrame_finish {n i : ℕ} (hi : 2 ≤ i) (hin : i + 2 ≤ n)
    (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (hzero : κ 0 = 1) :
    (firstPairFrame hi hin).finish κ =
      ![κ 1, κ (i : ZMod n), κ ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n), 1] := by
  have hip : ((i - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) + 1 = (i : ZMod n) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ i)]
    simp
  have hwrap : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) + 1 = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n), ZMod.natCast_self]
    simp
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [Frame.finish, Frame.residue, firstPairFrame, hip, hwrap, hzero,
    Nat.cast_add]

def firstPairFrame {n i : ℕ} (hi : 2 ≤ i) (hin : i + 2 ≤ n) : Frame n where
  edge := ![0, i - 1, i, n - 1]
  strictMono := by
    apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> simp <;> omega
  lt_n := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> simp <;> omega

blocks.tex:
The four naturals are strictly increasing and below $n$ by the two
  inequalities.  The starts are the readings at the edges' initial vertices.
  The finishes are the readings at $e_j+1$: $0+1=1$, $(i-1)+1=i$, $i+1$, and
  $(n-1)+1=0$ in $\ZMod n$, where $\kappa_0=1$.

blocks.title: anchors from a rising leg
blocks.body:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item If a frame $F$ of $\kappa$ has start $(1,t,q,l)$ and finish
      $(p,q,h,1)$ with the hypotheses of \cref{thm:nfp_transition}, then
      $\kappa$ has a regular four-edge anchor.
    \item Let $\kappa\colon\ZMod n\to\RR$ be positive with $\kappa_0=1$,
      $\kappa_1<1$, $\kappa_{n-1}<1$, and let $2\le a\le k$, $k+2\le n$,
      $\kappa_{a-1}\le1<\kappa_a$, $j\mapsto\kappa_j$ strictly increasing on
      $[a,k]$, and $\Phi(\kappa_1,\kappa_{k-1},\kappa_k,\kappa_{n-1})\ge0$.
      Then $\kappa$ has a regular four-edge anchor.
    \item Let $\kappa>0$ be adjacent-unequal, $\kappa_0=1<\kappa_H$, $0$ a
      highest secondary peak for the marked index $H$
      (\cref{def:four_active_secondary_peak}), and
      $\Phi(\kappa_1,\kappa_{H-1},\kappa_H,\kappa_{-1})\ge0$.  Then $\kappa$
      has a regular four-edge anchor.
  \end{enumerate}

lean.code:
theorem nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_rising_mountain_terminal {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {a k : ℕ}
    (hκ : ∀ j, 0 < κ j) (hzero : κ 0 = 1)
    (hp : κ 1 < 1) (hl : κ ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) < 1)
    (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hak : a ≤ k) (hkn : k + 2 ≤ n)
    (hentry : κ ((a - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≤ 1) (hhigh : 1 < κ (a : ZMod n))
    (hrise : StrictMonoOn (fun j : ℕ => κ (j : ZMod n)) (Icc a k))
    (hterminal : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag (κ 1) (κ ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n))
      (κ (k : ZMod n)) (κ ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n))) : Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨i, hai, hik, hq, htq, hqh, hflag, hprev⟩ :=
    exists_firstPair_transition_on_rising_interval (by omega) hak hp hentry hhigh hrise hterminal
  have hi : 2 ≤ i := by omega
  have hin : i + 2 ≤ n := by omega
  let F := firstPairFrame hi hin
  exact F.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_firstPair_transition (firstPairFrame_start hi hin κ hzero)
    (firstPairFrame_finish hi hin κ hzero) (hκ 1) hp (hκ _) htq (hκ _) hl
    hq hqh hflag hprev

theorem FourActiveSlots.Frame.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_firstPair_transition
    {n : ℕ} (F : FourActiveSlots.Frame n)
    {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {p t q h l : ℝ}
    (hstart : F.start κ = ![1, t, q, l])

theorem HighestSecondaryPeak.nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_rising_terminal {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {H : ZMod n} (hq : HighestSecondaryPeak κ H 0)
    (hκ : ∀ j, 0 < κ j) (hne : ∀ j, κ j ≠ κ (j + 1))
    (hzero : κ 0 = 1) (hH : 1 < κ H)
    (hterminal : 0 ≤ firstPairFlag (κ 1) (κ ((H.val - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n))
      (κ H) (κ (-1))) : Nonempty (RegularFourAnchor κ) := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hak, hkb, hbn, hset, hrise, -⟩ :=
    hq.exists_mountain hne (by simpa only [hzero] using hH)
  simp only [sub_zero, zero_add] at hak hkb hset hrise
  have hkn : H.val + 2 ≤ n := by omega
  have ha_lt : a < n := by omega
  have hwrap : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = -1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n), ZMod.natCast_self]
    simp
  have hp : κ 1 < 1 := by simpa [hzero] using hq.is_peak.2
  have hl : κ ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) < 1 := by
    simpa [hwrap, hzero] using hq.is_peak.1
  have hentry : κ ((a - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have hh : κ 0 < κ ((a - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by simpa only [hzero] using lt_of_not_ge h
    have hbad := ((hset (a - 1) (by omega)).mp hh).1
    omega
  have hhigh : 1 < κ (a : ZMod n) := by
    have hh := (hset a ha_lt).mpr ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩
    simpa only [hzero] using hh
  apply nonempty_regularFourAnchor_of_rising_mountain_terminal hκ hzero hp hl ha hak hkn hentry hhigh hrise
  simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, hwrap] using hterminal

(1) \Cref{thm:nfp_transition} gives a physical regular native zero $L$ and
  \cref{lem:nfp_to_anchor} packages $(F,L)$ as an anchor
  (\verb|RegularFourAnchor.ofNative|).

  (2) Apply \cref{lem:nfp_rising_transition} to $w(j)=\kappa_j$ with
  $p=\kappa_1$, $l=\kappa_{n-1}$.  It returns $i$ with $a\le i<k$, so
  $2\le i$ and $i+2\le k+1<n$.  The frame of \cref{lem:nfp_frame} has start
  $(1,t,q,l)$ and finish $(p,q,h,1)$ with $t=\kappa_{i-1}$, $q=\kappa_i$,
  $h=\kappa_{i+1}$.  Positivity of the word gives $p,t,l>0$; the selector
  gives $1<q$, $t<q<h$ and the two flags.  Apply (1).  The edges
  $0,i-1,i,n-1$ are actual edges of the original word; every other reading
  of $\kappa$ remains in the word and is opened later by
  \cref{thm:regular_four_anchor_realizes}.

  (3) By \cref{lem:four_active_mountain} (with $q=0$) there are
  $2\le a\le H\le b\le n-2$ (identifying $H$ with its natural
  representative) such that the readings above $\kappa_0=1$ are exactly
  those at offsets in $[a,b]$, rising strictly on $[a,H]$.  Since $0$ is a
  strict local maximum, $\kappa_1<1$ and $\kappa_{-1}=\kappa_{n-1}<1$; since
  $a-1\notin[a,b]$, $\kappa_{a-1}\le1$; and $\kappa_a>1$.  With $k=H$,
  $k+2\le n$, so (2) applies.  The mountain lemma is proved in
  \cref{chap:discrete_mountain_anchor_transport} (\cref{thm:mt_mountain}),
  where these entry data are recorded as \cref{lem:mt_normalized_entry}.
